```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     箱の内側で種から6近傍の非境界セルを塗る。部屋の上限を1つ超えた時点で打ち切る
    ///     Fills non-boundary cells six-connected from the seeds inside the box, stopping one past the room cap
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakFlood
    {
        public static HashSet<Vector3Int> FillInsideBox(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> seeds, CleanRoomLeakBox box)
        {
            var visited = new HashSet<Vector3Int>();
            var queue = new Queue<Vector3Int>();
            foreach (var seed in seeds)
            {
                if (visited.Add(seed)) queue.Enqueue(seed);
            }

            while (queue.Count > 0 && visited.Count <= CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume)
            {
                var cell = queue.Dequeue();
                foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    var next = cell + direction;
                    if (!box.Contains(next) || visited.Contains(next) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, next)) continue;
                    visited.Add(next);
                    queue.Enqueue(next);
                }
            }

            return visited;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     箱の面の外側1層が、まだ壁で囲われているかを調べる
    ///     Checks whether the layer just outside a box face is still enclosed by walls
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakLayerTest
    {
        // 露出セルの外隣から層内4近傍に空きを塗り、箱の側面の縁へ届かなければ囲われている
        // Fill free cells in-layer from the exposed cells' outer neighbors; the layer is enclosed if none reaches the side rim
        public static bool IsLayerEnclosed(IWorldBlockDatastore world, CleanRoomLeakBox box, Vector3Int direction, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> exposedFaceCells)
        {
            var normalAxis = CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(direction);
            var visited = new HashSet<Vector3Int>();
            var queue = new Queue<Vector3Int>();
            foreach (var faceCell in exposedFaceCells)
            {
                var start = faceCell + direction;
                if (visited.Add(start)) queue.Enqueue(start);
            }

            while (queue.Count > 0)
            {
                var cell = queue.Dequeue();

                // 縁に届いた空きは箱の外へ抜けているので、この層は囲われていない
                // A free cell on the rim escapes the box, so this layer is not enclosed
                if (box.IsOnLateralEdge(cell, direction)) return false;
                foreach (var inLayerDirection in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    if (CleanRoomLeakRays.AxisOf(inLayerDirection) == normalAxis) continue;
                    var next = cell + inLayerDirection;
                    if (visited.Contains(next) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, next)) continue;
                    visited.Add(next);
                    queue.Enqueue(next);
                }
            }

            return true;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.CleanRoom/Info/Leak/CleanRoomLeakProbe.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     密閉できていない構造の漏れ箇所を探す。
    ///     最も囲まれた種から軸レイで壁の箱を推定して中を塗り、箱の面に出た空きのうち外へ抜けるものを漏れとする。
    ///     面の外側1層がまだ境界で囲われていれば、箱をその面へ1層広げて探し直す（一面が抜けた部屋で残った境界の縁まで伸ばすため）。
    ///     Finds the openings of an unsealed structure.
    ///     It estimates the wall box with axis rays from the most enclosed seeds, fills it, and reports exposed face cells that escape outward.
    ///     If the layer beyond a face is still enclosed by boundaries, the box grows one layer on that face and the search repeats (so a room missing a whole face reaches the rim of the remaining boundary).
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomLeakProbe
    {
        // 6方向レイのうち境界に当たる本数がこれ未満の種は部屋の内側とみなさない
        // Seeds whose six rays hit fewer boundaries than this are not treated as a room interior
        private const int MinEnclosingRayHits = 4;

        // 面を広げる回数の上限（壁が延々続く構造で探索を打ち切る）
        // Cap on face growths, stopping endless wall structures
        private const int MaxFaceGrowths = 64;

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport ProbeFromBoundary(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> boundaryCells)
        {
            // 境界ブロックの両側（6近傍の空き）を種の候補にし、より囲まれた側を後で選ぶ
            // Both sides of the boundary block (free six-neighbors) become candidates; the more enclosed side wins later
            var candidates = new List<Vector3Int>();
            foreach (var cell in boundaryCells)
            foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
            {
                var neighbor = cell + direction;
                if (candidates.Contains(neighbor) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, neighbor)) continue;
                candidates.Add(neighbor);
            }

            return ProbeFromSeeds(world, candidates);
        }

        public static CleanRoomLeakReport ProbeFromSeeds(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> seedCandidates)
        {
            var seeds = new List<Vector3Int>();
            var rayHits = new List<Vector3Int>();
            SelectMostEnclosedSeeds(world, seedCandidates, seeds, rayHits);
            if (seeds.Count == 0) return CleanRoomLeakReport.NoEnclosure();

            var box = new CleanRoomLeakBox(seeds[0]);
            foreach (var cell in seeds) box.Include(cell);
            foreach (var cell in rayHits) box.Include(cell);

            for (var growth = 0; growth <= MaxFaceGrowths; growth++)
            {
                var visited = CleanRoomLeakFlood.FillInsideBox(world, seeds, box);
                if (CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume < visited.Count) return CleanRoomLeakReport.TooLarge();

                // 面ごとに、壁が続いていれば箱を広げ、続いていなければ露出セルを漏れとして集める
                // Per face, grow the box if walls continue; otherwise collect the exposed cells as openings
                var openings = new List<Vector3Int>();
                var grown = false;
                foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    var exposed = CollectExposedFaceCells(visited, direction);
                    if (exposed.Count == 0) continue;
                    if (CleanRoomLeakLayerTest.IsLayerEnclosed(world, box, direction, exposed))
                    {
                        box.GrowFace(direction);
                        grown = true;
                        continue;
                    }

                    openings.AddRange(exposed);
                }

                if (grown) continue;
                return openings.Count == 0 ? CleanRoomLeakReport.DetectionPending() : CleanRoomLeakReport.Openings(openings);
            }

            // 壁が延々続く構造は部屋の上限を超える大きさとして扱う
            // An endlessly walled structure is treated as larger than the room cap
            return CleanRoomLeakReport.TooLarge();

            #region Internal

            List<Vector3Int> CollectExposedFaceCells(HashSet<Vector3Int> visited, Vector3Int direction)
            {
                // 面上の塗りセルのうち、外側の隣が空いているもの
                // Filled cells on the face whose outer neighbor is free
                var exposed = new List<Vector3Int>();
                foreach (var cell in visited)
                {
                    if (!box.IsOnFace(cell, direction) || CleanRoomLeakRays.IsBoundary(world, cell + direction)) continue;
                    exposed.Add(cell);
                }

                return exposed;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private static void SelectMostEnclosedSeeds(IWorldBlockDatastore world, IReadOnlyList<Vector3Int> candidates, List<Vector3Int> seeds, List<Vector3Int> rayHits)
        {
            // 6方向レイが境界に当たる本数で採点し、最多（下限以上）の候補とその命中セルだけを残す
            // Score candidates by boundary hits of six rays and keep only the best ones (at or above the minimum) with their hits
            var bestHitCount = MinEnclosingRayHits;
            foreach (var candidate in candidates)
            {
                var hits = new List<Vector3Int>();
                foreach (var direction in CleanRoomLeakRays.Directions)
                {
                    if (CleanRoomLeakRays.TryCastToBoundary(world, candidate, direction, out var hit)) hits.Add(hit);
                }

                if (hits.Count < bestHitCount) continue;
                if (bestHitCount < hits.Count)
                {
                    bestHitCount = hits.Count;
                    seeds.Clear();
                    rayHits.Clear();
                }

                seeds.Add(candidate);
                rayHits.AddRange(hits);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info.Leak;
using Game.World.Interface.DataStore;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.CleanRoom.Info
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ブロック1つから見た部屋の状態を組み立てる（UI・ツールチップ用の読み取り専用照会）
    ///     Builds the room state seen from one block, a read-only query for UI and tooltips
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomInfoQuery
    {
        private static readonly Vector3Int[] TwentySixOffsets = BuildTwentySixOffsets();

        private readonly CleanRoomDatastore _datastore;
        private readonly IWorldBlockDatastore _world;

        public CleanRoomInfoQuery(CleanRoomDatastore datastore, IWorldBlockDatastore world)
        {
            _datastore = datastore;
            _world = world;
        }

        public CleanRoomInfo Query(IBlock block)
        {
            var cells = block.BlockPositionInfo.EnumeratePositions().ToList();
            var isBoundary = block.ExistsComponent<ICleanRoomBoundaryComponent>();

            // 境界は隣接する部屋、室内のブロックは自分が属する部屋を引く
            // A boundary resolves its adjacent rooms; an interior block resolves the room it belongs to
            var rooms = isBoundary ? CollectAdjacentRooms() : CollectOwnRoom();
            if (rooms.Count > 0) return CleanRoomInfo.CreateEnclosed(rooms.Select(room => CleanRoomRoomSummary.Create(room, _world)).ToList());

            // 部屋が無ければ漏れ箇所を探して返す
            // Without a room, probe for the openings
            var leak = isBoundary ? CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromBoundary(_world, cells) : CleanRoomLeakProbe.ProbeFromSeeds(_world, cells);
            return CleanRoomInfo.CreateNotEnclosed(leak);

            #region Internal

            List<CleanRoom> CollectAdjacentRooms()
            {
                // 角の壁は6近傍に部屋セルを持たないため26近傍で探す
                // Corner walls have no room cell among six neighbors, so search the 26 neighbors
                var found = new List<CleanRoom>();
                foreach (var cell in cells)
                foreach (var offset in TwentySixOffsets)
                {
                    if (!_datastore.TryGetCleanRoomAt(cell + offset, out var room) || found.Contains(room)) continue;
                    found.Add(room);
                }

                return found;
            }

            List<CleanRoom> CollectOwnRoom()
            {
                return _datastore.TryGetCleanRoom(block, out var room) ? new List<CleanRoom> { room } : new List<CleanRoom>();
            }

            #endregion
        }

        private static Vector3Int[] BuildTwentySixOffsets()
        {
            var offsets = new List<Vector3Int>();
            for (var x = -1; x <= 1; x++)
            for (var y = -1; y <= 1; y++)
            for (var z = -1; z <= 1; z++)
            {
                if (x == 0 && y == 0 && z == 0) continue;
                offsets.Add(new Vector3Int(x, y, z));
            }

            return offsets.ToArray();
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Server.PacketTest.CleanRoom
{
    public class GetCleanRoomInfoProtocolTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void EnclosedRoomIsReturnedWithAirFilterTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 壁のIDで引くと、清浄機1台を持つ密閉済みの部屋が返る
            // Querying a wall ID returns the sealed room holding one purifier
            var wall = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(new Vector3Int(0, 2, 2));
            var response = Invoke(packet, wall.BlockInstanceId);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed, response.Kind);
            Assert.IsNull(response.Leak);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, response.Rooms.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(26, response.Rooms[0].Volume);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, response.Rooms[0].AirFilters.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), response.Rooms[0].AirFilters[0].Position.Vector3Int);
            Assert.AreEqual(5, response.Rooms[0].AirFilters[0].FilterItemCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void BreachedRoomReturnsOpeningCellsTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();
            var filter = CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers.BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

            // 壁を1枚壊すと、清浄機から引いた応答に壊した位置が漏れとして載る
            // Breaking one wall puts that cell into the leak cells of the purifier's response
            var response = Invoke(packet, filter.BlockInstanceId);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed, response.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, response.Rooms.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings, response.Leak.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, response.Leak.TotalOpeningCount);
            Assert.AreEqual(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), response.Leak.OpeningCells[0].Vector3Int);
        }

        [Test]
        public void UnknownBlockReturnsBlockNotFoundTest()
        {
            var packet = CreatePacket();

            // 存在しないブロックIDは BlockNotFound を返す
            // A missing block ID returns BlockNotFound
            var response = Invoke(packet, new BlockInstanceId(999999));
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound, response.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, response.Rooms.Count);
            Assert.IsNull(response.Leak);
        }

        private static PacketResponseCreator CreatePacket()
        {
            var (packet, _) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            return packet;
        }

        private static GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack Invoke(PacketResponseCreator packet, BlockInstanceId id)
        {
            var request = new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(id);
            var responseBytes = packet.GetPacketResponse(MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(request), Tests.Util.PlayerIdentity.BoundPacketContext.Bind(1));
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack>(responseBytes[0]);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using MessagePack;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    public enum CleanRoomInfoResponseKind
    {
        Enclosed,
        NotEnclosed,
        BlockNotFound,
    }

    public enum CleanRoomLeakResponseKind
    {
        Openings,
        NoEnclosure,
        TooLarge,
        DetectionPending,
    }

    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack
    {
        // Out のときは空文字
        // Empty when the room is Out
        [Key(0)] public string ClassName { get; set; }
        [Key(1)] public bool IsOut { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public double Concentration { get; set; }
        [Key(3)] public double AirChangeRate { get; set; }
        [Key(4)] public int Volume { get; set; }
        [Key(5)] public List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> AirFilters { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack() { }

        public CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(string className, bool isOut, double concentration, double airChangeRate, int volume, List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> airFilters)
        {
            ClassName = className;
            IsOut = isOut;
            Concentration = concentration;
            AirChangeRate = airChangeRate;
            Volume = volume;
            AirFilters = airFilters;
        }
    }

    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public Vector3IntMessagePack Position { get; set; }
        [Key(1)] public double PowerRatio { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public double RemovalVolumePerSecond { get; set; }
        [Key(3)] public int FilterItemCount { get; set; }
        [Key(4)] public double FilterRemainingRatio { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack() { }

        public CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(Vector3IntMessagePack position, double powerRatio, double removalVolumePerSecond, int filterItemCount, double filterRemainingRatio)
        {
            Position = position;
            PowerRatio = powerRatio;
            RemovalVolumePerSecond = removalVolumePerSecond;
            FilterItemCount = filterItemCount;
            FilterRemainingRatio = filterRemainingRatio;
        }
    }

    [MessagePackObject]
    public class CleanRoomLeakMessagePack
    {
        [Key(0)] public CleanRoomLeakResponseKind Kind { get; set; }

        // 表示上限まで。総数は TotalOpeningCount
        // Capped for display; the full count is TotalOpeningCount
        [Key(1)] public List<Vector3IntMessagePack> OpeningCells { get; set; }
        [Key(2)] public int TotalOpeningCount { get; set; }

        // TooLarge の文言に出す部屋の上限体積
        // Room volume cap shown in the TooLarge message
        [Key(3)] public int MaxRoomVolume { get; set; }

        [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
        public CleanRoomLeakMessagePack() { }

        public CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind kind, List<Vector3IntMessagePack> openingCells, int totalOpeningCount, int maxRoomVolume)
        {
            Kind = kind;
            OpeningCells = openingCells;
            TotalOpeningCount = totalOpeningCount;
            MaxRoomVolume = maxRoomVolume;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: プロトコル本体とドメインからの詰め替えを書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/CleanRoom/CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.CleanRoom.Util;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーの部屋照会結果をプロトコル専用の型へ詰め替える
    ///     Converts the server's room query result into protocol-only types
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory
    {
        public static GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CreateResponse(CleanRoomInfo info)
        {
            if (info.Kind == CleanRoomInfoKind.NotEnclosed)
            {
                return new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed, new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack>(), CreateLeak(info.Leak));
            }

            var rooms = info.Rooms.Select(CreateSummary).ToList();
            return new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed, rooms, null);
        }

        private static CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack CreateSummary(CleanRoomRoomSummary room)
        {
            var filters = room.AirFilters.Select(filter => new CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(
                new Vector3IntMessagePack(filter.Position),
                filter.Status.PowerRatio,
                filter.Status.RemovalVolumePerSecond,
                filter.Status.FilterItemCount,
                filter.Status.CurrentFilterRemainingRatio)).ToList();
            return new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack(room.ClassName, room.IsOut, room.Concentration, room.AirChangeRate, room.Volume, filters);
        }

        private static CleanRoomLeakMessagePack CreateLeak(CleanRoomLeakReport leak)
        {
            var cells = leak.OpeningCells.Select(cell => new Vector3IntMessagePack(cell)).ToList();
            return new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(ToResponseKind(leak.Kind), cells, leak.TotalOpeningCount, CleanRoomCellSets.MaxRoomVolume);
        }

        private static CleanRoomLeakResponseKind ToResponseKind(CleanRoomLeakKind kind)
        {
            return kind switch
            {
                CleanRoomLeakKind.Openings => CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings,
                CleanRoomLeakKind.NoEnclosure => CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.NoEnclosure,
                CleanRoomLeakKind.TooLarge => CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.TooLarge,
                CleanRoomLeakKind.DetectionPending => CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.DetectionPending,
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kind), kind, "未対応の漏れ種別 / Unsupported leak kind"),
            };
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Server.Protocol/PacketResponse/CleanRoom/GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.CleanRoom.Info;
using Game.Context;
using MessagePack;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace Server.Protocol.PacketResponse
{
    // 指定ブロックから見たクリーンルームの状態（部屋の要約または漏れ箇所）を取得するプロトコル
    // Protocol fetching the clean-room state seen from a block: room summaries or leak cells
    public class GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol : IPacketResponse
    {
        public const string ProtocolTag = "va:getCleanRoomInfo";

        private readonly CleanRoomInfoQuery _query;

        public GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol(ServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _query = new CleanRoomInfoQuery(serviceProvider.GetService<CleanRoomDatastore>(), ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore);
        }

        public ProtocolMessagePackBase GetResponse(byte[] payload, int requesterPlayerId)
        {
            var request = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack>(payload);

            // 照会の間にブロックが壊れていれば BlockNotFound を返し、クライアント側で警告を出す
            // If the block was removed before the query, return BlockNotFound so the client logs a warning
            var block = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(request.BlockInstanceId);
            if (block == null) return ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack.CreateBlockNotFound();

            return CleanRoomInfoMessagePackFactory.CreateResponse(_query.Query(block));
        }

        #region MessagePack

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            [Key(2)] public BlockInstanceId BlockInstanceId { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack() { }

            public RequestCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                BlockInstanceId = blockInstanceId;
            }
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack : ProtocolMessagePackBase
        {
            [Key(2)] public CleanRoomInfoResponseKind Kind { get; set; }

            // Enclosed のときだけ1件以上
            // One or more only when Enclosed
            [Key(3)] public List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> Rooms { get; set; }

            // NotEnclosed のときだけ非null
            // Non-null only when NotEnclosed
            [Key(4)] public CleanRoomLeakMessagePack Leak { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack() { }

            public ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind kind, List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> rooms, CleanRoomLeakMessagePack leak)
            {
                Tag = ProtocolTag;
                Kind = kind;
                Rooms = rooms;
                Leak = leak;
            }

            public static ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CreateBlockNotFound()
            {
                return new ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound, new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack>(), null);
            }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

```csharp
    public class CleanRoomMachineOperabilityTest
    {

        public void MachineOutsideAnyRoomReportsNotEnclosedTest()
        {

            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();

        [Test]
        public void OperabilityFollowsRoomClassAndBreachTest()
        {
            CleanRoomHatchTest.CreateServer();
            var filter = BuildSmallCleanRoomWithFilter();
            var machine = CleanRoomHatchTest.PlaceBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomMachineId, new Vector3Int(2, 1, 1));
            var notifications = 0;
            machine.GetComponent<CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent>().OnChangeBlockState.Subscribe(_ => notifications++);

            // 検出直後の部屋はOutから始まるので、クラス不足として止まる
            // A freshly detected room starts at Out, so the machine halts for an insufficient class
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut, ReadOperability(machine));

            // 清浄機を回してクラスに届けば稼働可になる
            // Running the purifier until a class is reached makes the machine operable
            for (var i = 0; i < 3000 && ReadOperability(machine) != CleanRoomOperability.Operable; i++) TickRoom(filter, machine);
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.Operable, ReadOperability(machine));

            // 壁を壊すと未密閉に変わる
            // Breaking a wall turns it to not enclosed
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.RemoveBlock(new Vector3Int(2, 2, 0), BlockRemoveReason.ManualRemove);
            GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            Assert.AreEqual(CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed, ReadOperability(machine));

            // 毎tick同じ値を押し込んでも、通知は変化した3回だけ
            // Although the same value is pushed every tick, only the three changes notify
            Assert.AreEqual(3, notifications);
        }

        private static CleanRoomOperability ReadOperability(IBlock machine)
        {
            var bytes = machine.GetBlockState().CurrentStateDetails[CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey];
            return MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail>(bytes).Operability;
        }
    }
}
```

`IBlock.GetBlockState()` は `Game.Block.Interface/IBlock.cs:25` にある。

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Interface.Component
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     クリーンルームが内部の機械へ押し込む稼働可否と品質効果
    ///     Operate permission and quality effect a clean room pushes into interior machines
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct CleanRoomEffect
    {
        // 密閉部屋内かつ閾値行がOutでないときだけ Operable。止まる理由も区別して持つ
        // Operable only inside a sealed room whose row is not Out; the halt reason is kept distinct
        public readonly CleanRoomOperability Operability;
        public readonly int MaxChipLevel;
        public readonly double DownBinRate;

        public bool CanOperate => Operability == CleanRoomOperability.Operable;

        public CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability operability, int maxChipLevel, double downBinRate)
        {
            Operability = operability;
            MaxChipLevel = maxChipLevel;
            DownBinRate = downBinRate;
        }
    }
}
```

`CleanRoomMachineEffectService.PushEffects` のループ本体は、次のとおり3分岐にする:

```csharp
            foreach (var entry in _machines.Values)
            {
                if (entry.Machine.IsDestroy) continue;

                // 部屋未検出なら未密閉として最悪効果を押し込み停止させる
                // Without a detected room, push the worst effect as not enclosed so the machine halts
                if (!tryGetRoom(entry.Block, out var room))
                {
                    entry.Machine.SetCleanRoomEffect(new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed, 0, 0));
                    continue;
                }

                // 部屋はあるがOut行なら、クラス不足として停止させる
                // A room on the Out row halts the machine for an insufficient class
                if (MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.OutThresholdIndex <= room.ThresholdIndex)
                {
                    entry.Machine.SetCleanRoomEffect(new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut, 0, 0));
                    continue;
                }

                // 非Out行のマスタ効果だけを稼働許可として機械へ渡す
                // Only non-Out threshold master effects grant machine operation
                var row = MasterHolder.CleanRoomMaster.Thresholds[room.ThresholdIndex];
                entry.Machine.SetCleanRoomEffect(new CleanRoomEffect(CleanRoomOperability.Operable, row.MaxChipLevel, row.DownBinRate));
            }
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using UniRx;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    // 部屋から押し込まれた稼働可否を保持し、変化したときだけブロック状態として通知する
    // Holds the operability pushed by the room and notifies a block state change only when it changes
    public class CleanRoomOperabilityStateComponent : IBlockStateObservable
    {
        public IObservable<Unit> OnChangeBlockState => _onChangeBlockState;
        private readonly Subject<Unit> _onChangeBlockState = new();

        // 部屋の効果が届く前は、効果の既定値と同じく未密閉として扱う
        // Before any room effect arrives, treat the machine as not enclosed like the effect default
        public CleanRoomOperability Operability { get; private set; } = CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed;

        public void SetOperability(CleanRoomOperability operability)
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);

            // 毎tick同じ値が届くため、変化したときだけ通知する
            // The same value arrives every tick, so notify only on change
            if (Operability == operability) return;
            Operability = operability;
            _onChangeBlockState.OnNext(Unit.Default);
        }

        public BlockStateDetail[] GetBlockStateDetails()
        {
            BlockException.CheckDestroy(this);
            return new[] { CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail.CreateState(Operability) };
        }

        public bool IsDestroy { get; private set; }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            IsDestroy = true;
            _onChangeBlockState.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

`if (Operability == operability) return;` の早期 return は、同じ値の再設定を捨てる正常経路である。拒否や縮退ではないのでログは出さない。

```csharp
        private static void AssertMatchesFixture(object dto, string fixtureName)
        {

            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(expected, actual), $"fixture mismatch: {fixtureName}\nexpected: {expected}\nactual: {actual}");
        }
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.WebUiHost/Game/Topics/BlockDetail/CleanRoom/CleanRoomDetailDtoBuilder.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Game.InGame.Block;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.State;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.BlockDetail.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋照会の応答と機械の停止理由から、webui に送る部屋欄を組み立てる
    ///     Builds the room section for the webui from the room query response and the machine's halt reason
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomDetailDtoBuilder
    {
        public static void Apply(BlockInventoryDto dto, BlockGameObject block, BlockNetworkInfoCache cache)
        {
            // 未取得・ブロック消失の間は欄を出さない（キャッシュ側が警告ログを出している）
            // Omit the section while unfetched or after the block vanished; the cache already logged a warning
            if (cache.CleanRoom == null) return;
            var operability = block.GetStateDetail<CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail>(CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail.BlockStateDetailKey);
            dto.CleanRoom = Build(cache.CleanRoom, operability);
        }

        // 清浄機は停止理由の状態を持たないので operability は null で渡る
        // Purifiers carry no halt-reason state, so operability arrives as null
        public static CleanRoomDetailDto Build(GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack response, CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail operability)
        {
            var haltReason = ToHaltReason(operability);
            if (response.Kind == CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed)
            {
                return new CleanRoomDetailDto { Kind = "enclosed", Room = BuildRoom(response.Rooms[0]), HaltReason = haltReason };
            }

            // NotEnclosed は漏れ種別ごとに件数か上限体積だけを添える
            // NotEnclosed attaches only the opening count or the volume cap, per leak kind
            var leak = response.Leak;
            return leak.Kind switch
            {
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings => new CleanRoomDetailDto { Kind = "openings", OpeningCount = leak.TotalOpeningCount, HaltReason = haltReason },
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.NoEnclosure => new CleanRoomDetailDto { Kind = "noEnclosure", HaltReason = haltReason },
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.TooLarge => new CleanRoomDetailDto { Kind = "tooLarge", MaxRoomVolume = leak.MaxRoomVolume, HaltReason = haltReason },
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.DetectionPending => new CleanRoomDetailDto { Kind = "detecting", HaltReason = haltReason },
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(leak.Kind), leak.Kind, "未対応の漏れ種別 / Unsupported leak kind"),
            };
        }

        private static CleanRoomSummaryDto BuildRoom(CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack room)
        {
            return new CleanRoomSummaryDto
            {
                ClassName = room.ClassName,
                IsOut = room.IsOut,
                Concentration = room.Concentration,
                AirChangeRate = room.AirChangeRate,
                Volume = room.Volume,
                AirFilters = room.AirFilters.Select(filter => new CleanRoomAirFilterDto
                {
                    X = filter.Position.X,
                    Y = filter.Position.Y,
                    Z = filter.Position.Z,
                    PowerRatio = filter.PowerRatio,
                    FilterItemCount = filter.FilterItemCount,
                    FilterRemainingRatio = filter.FilterRemainingRatio,
                }).ToList(),
            };
        }

        private static string ToHaltReason(CleanRoomOperabilityStateDetail operability)
        {
            if (operability == null) return null;
            return operability.Operability switch
            {
                CleanRoomOperability.NotEnclosed => "notEnclosed",
                CleanRoomOperability.ClassOut => "classOut",
                CleanRoomOperability.Operable => null,
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(operability.Operability), operability.Operability, "未対応の稼働可否 / Unsupported operability"),
            };
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: キャッシュに部屋の照会を足し、網の判定を移す**

`BlockNetworkInfoCache.cs` を次のように変える。
- `using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;` を足す。
- クラス先頭の要約コメントの箇条に `- cleanRoom: 1秒ポーリング` と `- cleanRoom: 1s polling` を足す。
- プロパティ `public GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack CleanRoom { get; private set; }` を `FilterSplitter` の次に足す。
- `Track` を次で置き換える:

```csharp
        // 開いたブロックに合わせて取得を開始する。ブロックが変わったら前の取得を打ち切る
        // Start fetching for the opened block; cancel previous fetches when the block changes
        public void Track(BlockGameObject block)
        {
            if (block != null && block.BlockPosInfo.OriginalPos == _currentPos && _cts != null) return;
            Clear();
            if (block == null) return;
            _currentPos = block.BlockPosInfo.OriginalPos;
            _cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

            // ネットワーク所属はマスタの接続paramが答える。blockTypeの列挙は新種別を取りこぼす
            // The master's connection params answer which networks a block joins; enumerating blockTypes drops new kinds
            var param = block.BlockMasterElement.BlockParam;
            if (param is IElectricWireConnectParam) PollElectric(block, _cts.Token).Forget();
            if (param is IGearConnectors) PollGear(block, _cts.Token).Forget();
            if (block.BlockMasterElement.BlockType == "FilterSplitter") FetchFilterSplitter(block.BlockPosInfo.OriginalPos, _cts.Token).Forget();

            // 室内機械と清浄機は、開いている間ずっと部屋の状態を追う
            // Interior machines and purifiers follow the room state while open
            if (param is CleanRoomMachineBlockParam or CleanRoomAirFilterBlockParam) PollCleanRoom(block, _cts.Token).Forget();
        }
```

- `Clear()` の `FilterSplitter = null;` の次に `CleanRoom = null;` を足す。
- `PollGear` の直後に次を足す:

```csharp
        private async UniTaskVoid PollCleanRoom(BlockGameObject block, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            // PollElectric と同じ1秒間隔ポーリング（部屋の検出・清浄化の進み具合を追う）
            // Same 1-second polling as PollElectric, following room detection and purification progress
            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var response = await ClientContext.VanillaApi.Response.World.GetCleanRoomInfo(block.BlockInstanceId, ct);
                if (ct.IsCancellationRequested) return;

                // 通信失敗は前回値を保つ。ブロック消失は欄を消す。どちらも警告を出す
                // Keep the last value on a transport failure and clear it when the block vanished; warn in both cases
                if (response == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"[BlockNetworkInfoCache] GetCleanRoomInfo failed for block {block.BlockInstanceId}; keeping the previous clean room snapshot");
                }
                else if (response.Kind == CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"[BlockNetworkInfoCache] GetCleanRoomInfo found no block {block.BlockInstanceId}; clearing the clean room snapshot");
                    CleanRoom = null;
                    OnUpdated?.Invoke();
                }
                else
                {
                    CleanRoom = response;
                    OnUpdated?.Invoke();
                }

                await UniTask.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), cancellationToken: ct);
            }
        }
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

// 室内機械・清浄機の部屋欄。種別ごとに持つフィールドが決まる
// Room section of interior machines and purifiers; each kind fixes which fields it carries
const CleanRoomHaltReasonSchema = z.enum(["notEnclosed", "classOut"]);
export const CleanRoomAirFilterDataSchema = z.object({
  x: z.number().int(),
  y: z.number().int(),
  z: z.number().int(),
  powerRatio: z.number().nonnegative(),
  filterItemCount: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  filterRemainingRatio: z.number().min(0).max(1),
}).strict();
export const CleanRoomSummaryDataSchema = z.object({
  // Out のときは空文字
  // Empty when the room is Out
  className: z.string(),
  isOut: z.boolean(),
  concentration: z.number().nonnegative(),
  airChangeRate: z.number().nonnegative(),
  volume: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  airFilters: z.array(CleanRoomAirFilterDataSchema),
}).strict();
export const CleanRoomDetailDataSchema = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("enclosed"), room: CleanRoomSummaryDataSchema, haltReason: CleanRoomHaltReasonSchema.optional() }).strict(),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("openings"), openingCount: z.number().int().positive(), haltReason: CleanRoomHaltReasonSchema.optional() }).strict(),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("noEnclosure"), haltReason: CleanRoomHaltReasonSchema.optional() }).strict(),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("tooLarge"), maxRoomVolume: z.number().int().positive(), haltReason: CleanRoomHaltReasonSchema.optional() }).strict(),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("detecting"), haltReason: CleanRoomHaltReasonSchema.optional() }).strict(),
]);
```

C# の生成キーを再生成させるため、Client.Localization の再コンパイル印を CSV の内容に合わせる。SchemaWatcher と同じ計算（Localization 配下の全ファイルの MD5 を相対パス順に連結し、さらに MD5 を取る）を行う:

```bash
python3 - <<'EOF'
import hashlib, os, re
root = "Localization"
items = []
for dirpath, _, files in os.walk(root):
    for name in files:
        path = os.path.join(dirpath, name)
        digest = "-".join("%02X" % b for b in hashlib.md5(open(path, "rb").read()).digest())
        items.append((os.path.relpath(path, root).replace("\\", "/"), digest))
source = "".join(rel + "\0" + digest + "\0" for rel, digest in sorted(items))
token = "-".join("%02X" % b for b in hashlib.md5(source.encode()).digest())
requester = "moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Localization/_CompileRequester.cs"
text = open(requester, encoding="utf-8").read()
text = re.sub(r'dummyText = "[^"]*"', 'dummyText = "%s"' % token, text)
open(requester, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
print(token)
EOF
```

この計算は、変更前の CSV で現行の値 `24-09-A2-CA-6B-34-18-DC-BB-52-BF-DA-57-C4-9B-64` を再現することを確かめてある。Editor の SchemaWatcher が先に書き換えていれば、同じ値になる。

```ts
    expect(view.filters).toEqual([{ key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomFilter, params: { index: "1", power: "76", count: "5", remaining: "50" } }]);
    expect(view.noFilter).toBeNull();

  });

  it("Outの部屋は赤で示し、清浄機が無ければその旨を出す", () => {
    const view = cleanRoomDisplay({ kind: "enclosed", room: { ...room, className: "", isOut: true, airFilters: [] }, haltReason: "classOut" });
    expect(view.headline).toEqual({ key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomClassOut });
```

`moorestech_web/webui/src/features/blockInventory/details/cleanRoom/cleanRoomLogic.ts`:

```ts
import type { CleanRoomDetailData, CleanRoomSummaryData } from "@/bridge";
import { L, type InterpolationValues, type TranslationKey } from "@/shared/i18n";

export type CleanRoomLine = { key: TranslationKey; params?: InterpolationValues };
export type CleanRoomDisplay = {
  headline: CleanRoomLine;
  headlineInsufficient: boolean;
  air: CleanRoomLine | null;
  filters: CleanRoomLine[];
  noFilter: CleanRoomLine | null;
  haltReason: CleanRoomLine | null;
};

// 部屋欄の各行のキーと引数を作る。赤（不足）は「稼働を妨げている」行だけに付ける
// Builds keys and params for each room row; red (insufficient) only marks rows that block operation
export function cleanRoomDisplay(cleanRoom: CleanRoomDetailData): CleanRoomDisplay {
  const haltReason = haltReasonLine(cleanRoom.haltReason);
  switch (cleanRoom.kind) {
    case "enclosed":
      return { ...enclosedRows(cleanRoom.room), haltReason };
    case "openings":
      return headlineOnly({ key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomNotSealed, params: { count: String(cleanRoom.openingCount) } }, true, haltReason);
    case "noEnclosure":
      return headlineOnly({ key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomNoEnclosure }, true, haltReason);
    case "tooLarge":
      return headlineOnly({ key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomTooLarge, params: { max: String(cleanRoom.maxRoomVolume) } }, true, haltReason);
    case "detecting":
      // 検出待ちは数tickで解消するので赤にしない
      // Pending detection resolves within ticks, so it is not red
      return headlineOnly({ key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomDetecting }, false, haltReason);
  }
}

function enclosedRows(room: CleanRoomSummaryData): Omit<CleanRoomDisplay, "haltReason"> {
  const headline: CleanRoomLine = room.isOut
    ? { key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomClassOut }
    : { key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomClass, params: { className: room.className } };
  const filters = room.airFilters.map((filter, index): CleanRoomLine => ({
    key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomFilter,
    params: {
      index: String(index + 1),
      power: String(Math.round(filter.powerRatio * 100)),
      count: String(filter.filterItemCount),
      remaining: String(Math.round(filter.filterRemainingRatio * 100)),
    },
  }));
  return {
    headline,
    headlineInsufficient: room.isOut,
    air: { key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomAir, params: { concentration: room.concentration.toFixed(3), airChangeRate: room.airChangeRate.toFixed(3) } },
    filters,
    noFilter: filters.length === 0 ? { key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomNoFilter } : null,
  };
}

function headlineOnly(headline: CleanRoomLine, insufficient: boolean, haltReason: CleanRoomLine | null): CleanRoomDisplay {
  return { headline, headlineInsufficient: insufficient, air: null, filters: [], noFilter: null, haltReason };
}

function haltReasonLine(haltReason: CleanRoomDetailData["haltReason"]): CleanRoomLine | null {
  if (haltReason === "notEnclosed") return { key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomHaltNotEnclosed };
  if (haltReason === "classOut") return { key: L.ui.blockInventory.cleanRoomHaltClassOut };
  return null;
}
```

```tsx
import { Stack, Text } from "@mantine/core";
import type { BlockInventoryOpen } from "@/bridge";
import { useI18n } from "@/shared/i18n";
import LackHighlightText from "../LackHighlightText";
import { cleanRoomDisplay } from "./cleanRoomLogic";

// 部屋欄: クラス（または密閉できていない理由）・空気・清浄機・機械の停止理由を最上部に並べる
// Room section: class (or why it is not sealed), air, purifiers and the machine's halt reason at the top
export default function CleanRoomSection({ data }: { data: BlockInventoryOpen }) {
  const { t } = useI18n();
  if (!data.cleanRoom) return null;
  const view = cleanRoomDisplay(data.cleanRoom);
  return (
    <Stack gap={2} data-testid="clean-room-section">
      <LackHighlightText size="sm" insufficient={view.headlineInsufficient} testId="clean-room-headline">
        {t(view.headline.key, view.headline.params)}
      </LackHighlightText>
      {view.air ? (
        <Text size="sm" c="var(--text-default)" data-testid="clean-room-air">
          {t(view.air.key, view.air.params)}
        </Text>
      ) : null}
      {view.filters.map((filter, index) => (
        <Text key={index} size="xs" c="var(--text-default)" data-testid={`clean-room-air-filter-${index}`}>
          {t(filter.key, filter.params)}
        </Text>
      ))}
      {view.noFilter ? (
        <LackHighlightText size="xs" insufficient testId="clean-room-no-filter">
          {t(view.noFilter.key)}
        </LackHighlightText>
      ) : null}
      {view.haltReason ? (
        <LackHighlightText size="sm" insufficient testId="clean-room-halt-reason">
          {t(view.haltReason.key)}
        </LackHighlightText>
      ) : null}
    </Stack>
  );
}
```

- マーカーは照準中だけ出す。照準を外す、または GameScreen を出ると消す。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;

namespace Client.Tests.CleanRoom
{
    public class CleanRoomTooltipLinesTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void EnclosedRoomsProduceClassAirAndFilterLinesPerRoomTest()
        {
            // 共有壁は2部屋分の3行ずつを出し、Out の部屋はクラス未達の行になる
            // A shared wall yields three lines per room, and an Out room yields the below-class line
            var filter = new CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack(new Vector3IntMessagePack(1, 1, 1), 1d, 10d, 5, 1d);
            var classA = new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack("A", false, 0.1234d, 2d, 26, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack> { filter });
            var outRoom = new CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack("", true, 3d, 0d, 26, new List<CleanRoomAirFilterMessagePack>());
            var response = new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed, new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> { classA, outRoom }, null);

            var lines = CleanRoomTooltipLines.Build(response);
            Assert.AreEqual(6, lines.Length);
            Assert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClass.Key, lines[0].Key.Key);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "A" }, lines[0].TextParams);
            Assert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomAir.Key, lines[1].Key.Key);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "0.123", "2.000" }, lines[1].TextParams);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "1" }, lines[2].TextParams);
            Assert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClassOut.Key, lines[3].Key.Key);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "0" }, lines[5].TextParams);
        }

        [TestCase(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings, "ui.tooltip.cleanRoomNotSealed", "7")]
        [TestCase(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.TooLarge, "ui.tooltip.cleanRoomTooLarge", "4096")]
        public void LeakWithCountProducesOneLineTest(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind kind, string expectedKey, string expectedParam)
        {
            var leak = new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(kind, new List<Vector3IntMessagePack>(), 7, 4096);
            var response = new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed, new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack>(), leak);

            var lines = CleanRoomTooltipLines.Build(response);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, lines.Length);
            Assert.AreEqual(expectedKey, lines[0].Key.Key);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { expectedParam }, lines[0].TextParams);
        }

        [TestCase(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.NoEnclosure, "ui.tooltip.cleanRoomNoEnclosure")]
        [TestCase(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.DetectionPending, "ui.tooltip.cleanRoomDetecting")]
        public void LeakWithoutCountProducesOneLineTest(CleanRoomLeakResponseKind kind, string expectedKey)
        {
            var leak = new CleanRoomLeakMessagePack(kind, new List<Vector3IntMessagePack>(), 0, 4096);
            var response = new GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack(CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed, new List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack>(), leak);

            var lines = CleanRoomTooltipLines.Build(response);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, lines.Length);
            Assert.AreEqual(expectedKey, lines[0].Key.Key);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, lines[0].TextParams.Count);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Client.Tests.CleanRoom
{
    public class CleanRoomTooltipPresenterTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void ShowsWhenFreeAndYieldsToOtherOwnersTest()
        {
            var tooltip = new MouseCursorTooltipState();
            var presenter = new CleanRoomTooltipPresenter(tooltip);
            var lines = new[] { new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomDetecting) };

            // 誰も出していなければ自分の行を出す
            // Show our lines when nobody else is showing
            presenter.Present(lines);
            Assert.IsTrue(tooltip.GetPresentation().Visible);
            Assert.AreEqual(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomDetecting.Key, tooltip.GetPresentation().Lines[0].Key.Key);
            var ourOwner = tooltip.CurrentOwner;

            // 他の書き手が出している間は上書きしない
            // Do not overwrite while another writer is showing
            var other = new TooltipOwner();
            tooltip.Show(other, LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.PlaceTooFar);
            presenter.Present(lines);
            Assert.AreSame(other, tooltip.CurrentOwner);

            // 自分の Hide は他者の表示を消さない
            // Our Hide never clears someone else's tooltip
            presenter.Hide();
            Assert.IsTrue(tooltip.GetPresentation().Visible);

            // 他者が消えたら再び出す
            // Show again once the other writer has hidden
            tooltip.Hide(other);
            presenter.Present(lines);
            Assert.IsNotNull(tooltip.CurrentOwner);
            Assert.AreNotSame(other, tooltip.CurrentOwner);
            Assert.AreSame(ourOwner, tooltip.CurrentOwner);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/CleanRoom/CleanRoomTooltipLines.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋照会の応答をカーソルツールチップの行にする（密閉済みは部屋ごとに3行、未密閉は理由1行）
    ///     Turns the room query response into cursor tooltip lines: three per sealed room, one reason line otherwise
    /// </summary>
    public static class CleanRoomTooltipLines
    {
        public static TooltipLine[] Build(GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack response)
        {
            if (response.Kind == CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.Enclosed) return BuildEnclosed(response.Rooms);
            if (response.Kind == CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed) return new[] { BuildLeak(response.Leak) };
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(response.Kind), response.Kind, "BlockNotFound は呼び出し側で処理する / BlockNotFound is handled by the caller");
        }

        private static TooltipLine[] BuildEnclosed(List<CleanRoomSummaryMessagePack> rooms)
        {
            // 共有壁は両側の部屋を順に並べる
            // A shared wall lists both rooms in order
            var lines = new List<TooltipLine>();
            foreach (var room in rooms)
            {
                lines.Add(room.IsOut ? new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClassOut) : new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClass, new[] { room.ClassName }));
                lines.Add(new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomAir, new[] { Format3(room.Concentration), Format3(room.AirChangeRate) }));
                lines.Add(new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomFilters, new[] { room.AirFilters.Count.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) }));
            }

            return lines.ToArray();
        }

        private static TooltipLine BuildLeak(CleanRoomLeakMessagePack leak)
        {
            return leak.Kind switch
            {
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings => new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomNotSealed, new[] { leak.TotalOpeningCount.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) }),
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.NoEnclosure => new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomNoEnclosure),
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.TooLarge => new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomTooLarge, new[] { leak.MaxRoomVolume.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) }),
                CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.DetectionPending => new TooltipLine(LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomDetecting),
                _ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(leak.Kind), leak.Kind, "未対応の漏れ種別 / Unsupported leak kind"),
            };
        }

        private static string Format3(double value)
        {
            return value.ToString("F3", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     部屋の要約をカーソルツールチップへ出す。他の書き手が出している間は譲る
    ///     Shows the room summary on the cursor tooltip, yielding while another writer is showing
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomTooltipPresenter
    {
        private readonly IMouseCursorTooltip _tooltip;
        private readonly TooltipOwner _tooltipOwner = new();
        private TooltipLine[] _lastShown = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();

        public CleanRoomTooltipPresenter(IMouseCursorTooltip tooltip)
        {
            _tooltip = tooltip;
        }

        // 毎フレーム呼ばれる。空き、または自分の表示で内容が変わったときだけ Show する
        // Called every frame; shows only when the tooltip is free or ours with changed content
        public void Present(IReadOnlyList<TooltipLine> lines)
        {
            var owner = _tooltip.CurrentOwner;

            // silent-ok: インタラクト案内・設置フィードバックが優先する正常な調停で、相手が消えた次フレームに出し直す / 部屋の要約が出ないことは照準中の画面で見える
            if (owner != null && !ReferenceEquals(owner, _tooltipOwner)) return;
            if (ReferenceEquals(owner, _tooltipOwner) && _lastShown.SequenceEqual(lines)) return;

            // TooltipPresentation は不変スナップショット前提のため複製を渡す
            // TooltipPresentation assumes an immutable snapshot, so hand over a copy
            _lastShown = lines.ToArray();
            _tooltip.Show(_tooltipOwner, _lastShown);
        }

        public void Hide()
        {
            _lastShown = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();
            _tooltip.Hide(_tooltipOwner);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/CleanRoom/CleanRoomLeakMarkerVisualizer.cs`:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.Common;
using Server.Util.MessagePack;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     漏れているセルに赤い半透明の箱を出す（設置不可プレビューと同じ材質・色）
    ///     Shows translucent red boxes on leaking cells, using the not-placeable preview material and color
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomLeakMarkerVisualizer
    {
        public const string MarkerName = "CleanRoomLeakMarker";
        private static readonly Vector3 MarkerScale = new(0.9f, 0.9f, 0.9f);
        private static readonly Vector3 CellCenterOffset = new(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);

        // 漏れセルは表示上限32件なので、使い回しの箱も最大32個
        // Leak cells are capped at 32 for display, so at most 32 pooled boxes exist
        private readonly List<GameObject> _markers = new();
        private Material _material;

        public void Show(IReadOnlyList<Vector3IntMessagePack> cells)
        {
            while (_markers.Count < cells.Count) _markers.Add(CreateMarker());
            for (var i = 0; i < _markers.Count; i++)
            {
                var visible = i < cells.Count;
                _markers[i].SetActive(visible);
                if (visible) _markers[i].transform.position = cells[i].Vector3Int + CellCenterOffset;
            }
        }

        public void HideAll()
        {
            foreach (var marker in _markers) marker.SetActive(false);
        }

        private GameObject CreateMarker()
        {
            // 材質は初回表示時に作る（プレビュー材質のロード完了後に呼ばれるため）
            // Create the material on first show, which happens after the preview material is loaded
            if (_material == null)
            {
                _material = new Material(MaterialConst.GetPreviewPlaceBlockMaterial());
                _material.SetColor(MaterialConst.PreviewColorPropertyName, MaterialConst.NotPlaceableColor);
            }

            var marker = GameObject.CreatePrimitive(PrimitiveType.Cube);
            marker.name = MarkerName;
            Object.Destroy(marker.GetComponent<Collider>());
            marker.transform.localScale = MarkerScale;
            marker.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterial = _material;
            marker.SetActive(false);
            return marker;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/CleanRoom/CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService.cs`:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using Client.Game.InGame.Block;
using Client.Game.InGame.Context;
using Client.Game.InGame.Control;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse;
using UnityEngine;
using static Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule.BlockMasterElement;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     壁・ドア・ハッチへの照準を追い、部屋の要約ツールチップと漏れマーカーを出す
    ///     Follows the aim on walls, doors and hatches, showing the room summary tooltip and leak markers
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService
    {
        private static readonly TimeSpan PollInterval = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);

        private readonly CleanRoomTooltipPresenter _tooltipPresenter;
        private readonly CleanRoomLeakMarkerVisualizer _markers = new();
        private BlockGameObject _trackingBlock;
        private CancellationTokenSource _pollCts;
        private TooltipLine[] _currentLines = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();

        public CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService(IMouseCursorTooltip tooltip)
        {
            _tooltipPresenter = new CleanRoomTooltipPresenter(tooltip);
        }

        public void ManualUpdate()
        {
            // 照準中の境界ブロックが変わったときだけ照会を張り直す
            // Restart the query only when the aimed boundary block changes
            var hovered = TryGetHoveredBoundary(out var block) ? block : null;
            if (!ReferenceEquals(hovered, _trackingBlock))
            {
                StopTracking();
                if (hovered == null) return;
                _trackingBlock = hovered;
                _pollCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                PollLoop(hovered.BlockInstanceId, _pollCts.Token).Forget();
            }

            // 他の書き手が消えた後でも出し直せるよう、手元の最新行で毎フレーム判定する
            // Re-evaluate every frame with the latest lines so we reappear once another writer hides
            if (_trackingBlock != null && _currentLines.Length > 0) _tooltipPresenter.Present(_currentLines);
        }

        public void Disable()
        {
            StopTracking();
        }

        private async UniTaskVoid PollLoop(BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, CancellationToken ct)
        {
            while (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var response = await ClientContext.VanillaApi.Response.World.GetCleanRoomInfo(blockInstanceId, ct);
                if (ct.IsCancellationRequested) return;
                Apply(response, blockInstanceId);
                await UniTask.Delay(PollInterval, cancellationToken: ct);
            }
        }

        private void Apply(GetCleanRoomInfoProtocol.ResponseCleanRoomInfoMessagePack response, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId)
        {
            // 通信失敗・ブロック消失は表示を消して警告を出す
            // On a transport failure or a vanished block, clear the display and warn
            if (response == null || response.Kind == CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.BlockNotFound)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"[CleanRoomBoundaryHoverService] GetCleanRoomInfo returned no room info for block {blockInstanceId}; hiding the room tooltip");
                _currentLines = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();
                _tooltipPresenter.Hide();
                _markers.HideAll();
                return;
            }

            _currentLines = CleanRoomTooltipLines.Build(response);
            _tooltipPresenter.Present(_currentLines);

            // 隙間があるときだけ、そのセルに印を出す
            // Mark the gap cells only when openings exist
            var hasOpenings = response.Kind == CleanRoomInfoResponseKind.NotEnclosed && response.Leak.Kind == CleanRoomLeakResponseKind.Openings;
            if (hasOpenings) _markers.Show(response.Leak.OpeningCells);
            else _markers.HideAll();
        }

        private void StopTracking()
        {
            _pollCts?.Cancel();
            _pollCts?.Dispose();
            _pollCts = null;
            _trackingBlock = null;
            _currentLines = Array.Empty<TooltipLine>();
            _tooltipPresenter.Hide();
            _markers.HideAll();
        }

        private static bool TryGetHoveredBoundary(out BlockGameObject block)
        {
            if (!BlockClickDetectUtil.TryGetCursorOnBlock(out block)) return false;
            var blockType = block.BlockMasterElement.BlockType;
            return blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomWall || blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomDoor ||
                   blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomItemHatch || blockType == BlockTypeConst.CleanRoomPipeHatch;
        }
    }
}
```

`BlockTypeConst` は blocks.yml から生成される型。クリーンルームパネル（A4）も `CleanRoomWall` 型なので、どの向きに置いてもこの判定で拾える。

### Task A11: unity プレイ録画テスト「パネルで部屋を建てて入る・フィルター投入・状態UI表示」

**Files:**
- Create: `.agents/skills/unity-playmode-recorded-playtest/scenarios/misc/cleanroom-room-usability.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: A1〜A10・A13 のすべて（master は `$MW/server_v8`。A2〜A4 のピンが指すコミット）
- Produces: `result.json` の `Success: true` と録画（RA1・RA5・RA6・RA11〜RA15 の受け入れ）

**シナリオの配置**（座標はすべてセル。地面の上面は y=32）:
- 床: 「クリーンルームパネル」を北向き（水平）で x=-2..8, z=-6..8, y=32 に並べる。
  - 板はセルの上端にあるので、立つ高さは y=33.0。
  - 室外まで広げるのは、ドアの前まで同じ高さで歩けるようにするため。
- 壁（y=33..34 の x=0..6, z=0..6 の外周。ドアの2セル (3,33..34,0) は空ける）: 板が室内側の面に来る向きでパネルを縦に置く。
  - 西 x=0 は UpWest（板は x=0.95 の面）。A13 で直す向き。
  - 南 z=0 は UpSouth（板は z=0.95 の面）。A13 で直す向き。
  - 東 x=6 は DownEast（板は x=0.05 の面）。ただし (6,33,4) の1枚は、ビルドメニューで選んで Shift+R で縦にし、クリックで置く。
  - 北 z=6 は「クリーンルームブロック」。パネルと壁ブロックを混ぜても部屋になることを見せる。
- 天井: パネルを北向き（水平）で x=0..6, z=0..6, y=35 に並べる。
- 清浄機は (1,33,5)、EUV は (3,33,3)（3×2×3）、発電機は (-15,32,-15)。給電は cleanroom-v2 と同じ。

**向きを変えて置く操作の前例:**
- `scenarios/misc/sprint/sprint-toggle-mode.cs:88-91` は、`SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.LeftShift)` → `p.PressKey(Key.R)` → `KeyUp` で設置中の向きを鉛直に回している。
- 通常ブロックの Shift+R は、水平回転の後に鉛直回転する（`PlacementDirectionKeyInput.cs:17-24`）。初期向き North なら UpEast になる。
- 置いた向きはサーバーのブロック（`IBlock.BlockPositionInfo.BlockDirection`）で確かめる。設置システムの内部状態は読まない。
- `PlaceBlockDirect` は向きを引数に取るので、縦向きの壁はそれで並べる。

- [ ] **Step 1: シナリオを書く**

`.agents/skills/unity-playmode-recorded-playtest/scenarios/misc/cleanroom-room-usability.cs`:

```csharp
// シナリオ: パネルを床・壁・天井に使いドアで部屋を建て、ドアを歩いて通り、清浄機のUIでフィルターを入れ、部屋欄とツールチップと漏れ表示を確かめる
// Scenario: build a room using panels as floor, walls and ceiling plus a door, walk through it, load filters via the purifier UI, then check the room section, tooltip and leak display
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Client.Game.InGame.CleanRoom;
using Client.Game.InGame.Context;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Inventory.Main;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.Tooltip;
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.UIState;
using Client.Playtest;
using Client.Playtest.Input;
using Client.Playtest.Operations;
using Core.Master;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Blocks.PowerGenerator;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.EnergySystem;
using Game.Fluid;
using Mooresmaster.Localization.Generated;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.Util.ElectricWire.Connection;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;

const string PanelName = "クリーンルームパネル";
var outsidePosition = new Vector3(3.5f, 33.5f, -3.5f); // ドア正面の室外（床の上）
var doorAimPoint = new Vector3(3.5f, 34f, 0.5f); // 1×2×1 ドアの中心
var breachCell = new Vector3Int(6, 33, 3); // 後で外す東の壁
var uiPanelCell = new Vector3Int(6, 33, 4); // Shift+R で縦にして UI で置く東の壁

var options = new PlaytestRunOptions { Record = true };
return PlaytestRunner.Run("cleanroom-room-usability", options, async p =>
{
    await p.SkipOpeningSkitIfPlaying();
    await p.Until(() => p.CurrentUiState == UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 15f, "GameScreenに到達");
    await p.SetupFlatGround();

    // 開始位置(0,33.5,0)は壁の角になるので、建てる前に室外へ退く。床は室外まで北向き(水平)のパネルで敷く
    // The spawn (0,33.5,0) becomes a wall corner, so step outside first; the floor is north-facing (flat) panels reaching outdoors
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    for (var x = -2; x <= 8; x++)
    for (var z = -6; z <= 8; z++)
        p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, new Vector3Int(x, 32, z), BlockDirection.North);
    await p.WaitBlockGameObject(new Vector3Int(6, 32, 4));
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);

    #region パネルを Shift+R で縦にして UI で置く / Stand a panel upright with Shift+R and place it via the UI
    p.WarpPlayer(new Vector3(4.5f, 33.5f, 1.5f));
    await p.PrepareBlockForUiPlacement(PanelName, 1);
    await p.OpenBuildMenuAndSelectBlock(PanelName);
    SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.LeftShift);
    await p.WaitSeconds(0.5f);
    await p.PressKey(Key.R);
    SemanticInput.KeyUp(Key.LeftShift);
    await p.AimAt(new Vector3(6.5f, 33f, 4.5f));
    await p.ClickPlace();
    await p.Until(() => p.GetBlock(uiPanelCell) != null, 15f, "UIで置いたパネルがサーバーに載った");
    var uiPanelDirection = p.GetBlock(uiPanelCell).BlockPositionInfo.BlockDirection;
    p.Assert(IsUpright(uiPanelDirection), $"Shift+Rでパネルが縦向き(Up*/Down*)になった(向き={uiPanelDirection})");
    await p.ExitToGameScreen();
    #endregion

    // 東西南の壁は板が室内側に来る縦向きのパネル、北の壁は壁ブロック、天井は北向きのパネルにする
    // East/west/south walls are upright panels with the plate facing inside, the north wall is wall blocks, the ceiling is north-facing panels
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    for (var x = 0; x <= 6; x++)
    for (var z = 0; z <= 6; z++)
    {
        p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, new Vector3Int(x, 35, z), BlockDirection.North);
        if (x != 0 && x != 6 && z != 0 && z != 6) continue;
        for (var y = 33; y <= 34; y++)
        {
            var cell = new Vector3Int(x, y, z);
            if ((x == 3 && z == 0) || cell == uiPanelCell) continue;
            if (x == 0) p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, cell, BlockDirection.UpWest);
            else if (x == 6) p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, cell, BlockDirection.DownEast);
            else if (z == 0) p.PlaceBlockDirect(PanelName, cell, BlockDirection.UpSouth);
            else p.PlaceBlockDirect("クリーンルームブロック", cell, BlockDirection.North);
        }
    }
    p.PlaceBlockDirect("クリーンルームドア", new Vector3Int(3, 33, 0), BlockDirection.North);
    var filterBlock = p.PlaceBlockDirect("クリーンルーム空気清浄機", new Vector3Int(1, 33, 5), BlockDirection.North);
    var machineBlock = p.PlaceBlockDirect("EUV露光式半導体製造装置", new Vector3Int(3, 33, 3), BlockDirection.North);
    WirePower(filterBlock, machineBlock);
    await p.WaitBlockGameObject(new Vector3Int(3, 33, 0));

    // 床(水平)・西(UpWest)・南(UpSouth)・UIで置いた東(縦)の板が、それぞれ自分のセルの中に描かれる
    // The floor (flat), west (UpWest), south (UpSouth) and UI-placed east (upright) plates each render inside their own cell
    foreach (var (plateCell, upright) in new[] { (new Vector3Int(2, 32, 2), false), (new Vector3Int(0, 33, 2), true), (new Vector3Int(1, 33, 0), true), (uiPanelCell, true) })
        await AssertPanelPlateInCell(plateCell, upright);

    // 密閉された部屋が検出されるのを待つ（クラスは問わない）
    // Wait for the sealed room to be detected, whatever its class
    var datastore = p.ServerService<CleanRoomDatastore>();
    await p.Until(() => datastore.TryGetCleanRoom(machineBlock, out _), 15f, "部屋が検出された");
    await p.Screenshot("01-room-built");

    #region ドアを歩いて通る / Walk through the door
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);
    p.Assert(0.7f < Camera.main.transform.forward.z, "カメラが北(+z)＝ドアを向いている");
    SemanticInput.KeyDown(Key.W);
    await p.Until(() => 1.2f < p.PlayerPosition.z, 10f, "Wで歩いてドアを抜け室内(z>1.2)に入った");
    SemanticInput.KeyUp(Key.W);
    p.Note($"室内の位置={p.PlayerPosition}");
    await p.Screenshot("02-inside-room");
    #endregion

    #region 清浄機のUIでフィルターを入れる / Load filters through the purifier UI
    p.GiveItemDirect("クリーンルームフィルター", 5);
    var filterItemId = PlaytestItemOps.ResolveItemId("クリーンルームフィルター");
    var localInventory = ClientDIContext.DIContainer.DIContainerResolver.Resolve<ILocalPlayerInventory>();
    await p.Until(() => FindMainSlot(localInventory, filterItemId) >= 0, 10f, "フィルターがクライアントのインベントリに届いた");
    var filterSlot = FindMainSlot(localInventory, filterItemId);

    await p.AimAt(new Vector3(1.5f, 34f, 5.5f));
    await p.PressInteract();
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 10f);
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-filter-grid-slot-0", 10f);
    await p.ClickWebUi($"main-slot-{filterSlot}");
    await p.ClickWebUi("clean-room-filter-grid-slot-0");
    Core.Inventory.IOpenableInventory filterInventory = filterBlock.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
    await p.Until(() => filterInventory.GetItem(0).Id == filterItemId && filterInventory.GetItem(0).Count == 5, 10f, "フィルター5個がスロットに入った");
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-section", 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("03-filter-loaded");
    await p.PressKey(Key.Tab);
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 10f);
    #endregion

    #region EUV の部屋欄 / Room section of the EUV
    await p.AimAt(new Vector3(4.5f, 34f, 4.5f));
    await p.PressInteract();
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 10f);
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-section", 10f);
    await p.UntilWebUiElement("clean-room-headline", 10f);
    await p.Screenshot("04-euv-room-section");
    await p.PressKey(Key.Tab);
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 10f);
    #endregion

    #region ドアのツールチップと漏れ表示 / Door tooltip and leak display
    p.WarpPlayer(outsidePosition);
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);
    await p.AimAt(doorAimPoint);
    await p.Until(() => FirstTooltipKey() == LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClass.Key || FirstTooltipKey() == LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomClassOut.Key, 5f, "ドアのツールチップ先頭行が部屋クラス");
    await p.Screenshot("05-door-tooltip-sealed");

    p.RemoveBlock(breachCell);
    await p.AimAt(doorAimPoint);
    await p.Until(() => FirstTooltipKey() == LocalizationKeys.Ui.Tooltip.CleanRoomNotSealed.Key, 10f, "壁を外すとドアのツールチップが未密閉になる");
    var expectedMarker = breachCell + new Vector3(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f);
    await p.Until(() => ActiveMarkers().Any(marker => Vector3.Distance(marker.position, expectedMarker) < 0.01f), 5f, "外した壁の位置に漏れマーカーが出た");
    p.Assert(ActiveMarkers().Length == 1, "漏れマーカーは外した1セルだけ");
    await p.Screenshot("06-door-tooltip-leak");
    #endregion

    #region ローカル関数 / Local functions
    bool IsUpright(BlockDirection direction) => Mathf.Abs((direction.GetRotation() * Vector3.up).y) < 0.5f;
    async UniTask AssertPanelPlateInCell(Vector3Int cell, bool expectUpright)
    {
        // 板の描画範囲がセルの中に収まり、縦なら高さ1・厚さ0.1、横なら高さ0.1になる
        // The plate's rendered bounds stay inside the cell: height 1 and thickness 0.1 when upright, height 0.1 when flat
        var blockObject = await p.WaitBlockGameObject(cell);
        var bounds = blockObject.GetComponentsInChildren<MeshRenderer>(true).First(renderer => renderer.gameObject.name == "PanelPlate").bounds;
        var cellBounds = new Bounds(cell + Vector3.one * 0.5f, Vector3.one * 1.02f);
        var insideCell = cellBounds.Contains(bounds.min) && cellBounds.Contains(bounds.max);
        var isUpright = 0.9f < bounds.size.y && Mathf.Min(bounds.size.x, bounds.size.z) < 0.15f;
        p.Assert(insideCell && isUpright == expectUpright, $"{cell} のパネルの板がセル内に{(expectUpright ? "縦" : "横")}で描かれる(bounds={bounds})");
    }
    int FindMainSlot(ILocalPlayerInventory inventory, ItemId itemId) =>
        Enumerable.Range(0, inventory.MainSlotCount).Where(i => inventory[i].Id == itemId && 0 < inventory[i].Count).DefaultIfEmpty(-1).First();
    string FirstTooltipKey()
    {
        var presentation = ClientDIContext.DIContainer.DIContainerResolver.Resolve<IMouseCursorTooltip>().GetPresentation();
        return presentation.Visible ? presentation.Lines[0].Key.Key : string.Empty;
    }
    Transform[] ActiveMarkers() => UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<MeshRenderer>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)
        .Where(renderer => renderer.gameObject.activeInHierarchy && renderer.gameObject.name == CleanRoomLeakMarkerVisualizer.MarkerName)
        .Select(renderer => renderer.transform).ToArray();
    void WirePower(IBlock filter, IBlock machine)
    {
        // cleanroom-v2 と同じく室外の発電機へ燃料を直接入れ、電線で清浄機と機械へ給電する
        // As in cleanroom-v2, fuel an outdoor generator directly and wire it to the purifier and machine
        var generatorBlock = p.PlaceBlockDirect("ガソリンエンジン発電機", new Vector3Int(-15, 32, -15), BlockDirection.North);
        var gasolineId = MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(new Guid("019eded2-7454-76da-8943-84c4e7a59179"));
        generatorBlock.GetComponent<VanillaElectricGeneratorComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(400, gasolineId), FluidContainer.Empty);
        var generatorConnector = generatorBlock.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>();
        var (filterConnector, machineConnector) = (filter.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>(), machine.GetComponent<IElectricWireConnector>());
        var freeCost = new ConnectionLineRecord(Guid.Parse("872372d5-2998-4fb7-826c-593ceeafcfb2"), Array.Empty<ConnectToolMaterialCost>());
        p.Assert(ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(generatorConnector, filterConnector, freeCost), "電線 発電機→清浄機");
        p.Assert(ElectricWireSystemUtil.TryConnectBothSides(generatorConnector, machineConnector, freeCost), "電線 発電機→EUV");
        p.ServerService<IElectricWireNetworkDatastore>().RebuildAround(generatorConnector, filterConnector, machineConnector);
    }
    #endregion
});
```
