## Part C: 機械の汎用機構

### Task C1: 品質モジュールの効き先制限

品質モジュールは `allowQualityModule: true` の機械（クリーンルームの成膜・EUV・ダイシング）にだけ置けて、効く。速度・省エネ・生産性はスロットを持つ全機械（クリーンルーム機械を含む）で従来どおり。品質の効果合計を読むのはクリーンルームの役割レシピの書き換え器（Part B）だけで、一般機械の出力を昇格させる汎用の品質シフト経路は C3 で撤去する。

**Files:**
- Modify: `VanillaSchema/blocks.yml`（defineInterface `IMachineParam` と、ElectricMachine・GearMachine・CleanRoomMachine の blockParam に `allowQualityModule` を足す）
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/_CompileRequester.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/MachineSlotPlacementCheck.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Inventory/VanillaMachineModuleInventory.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Module/MachineModuleEffectComponent.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Factory/BlockTemplate/BlockTemplateUtil.cs:70-72`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests.Module/TestMod/ForUnitTest/mods/forUnitTest/master/blocks.json`
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/ServerData/mods/EditModeInPlayingTestMod/master/blocks.json`
- Modify（moorestech_master）: `server_v8/mods/moorestechAlphaMod_8/master/blocks.json`
- Modify: `.moorestech-external-revisions.json`
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleQualityRestrictionTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: なし（Part A の後に着手。Part A はこれらのファイルに触れない前提）
- Produces:
  - スキーマ: `IMachineParam.AllowQualityModule`（`bool`。ElectricMachineBlockParam・GearMachineBlockParam・CleanRoomMachineBlockParam の必須キー `allowQualityModule`）。**Part B/D は成膜・EUV・ダイシングの機械ブロックに `"allowQualityModule": true`、それ以外の機械（ウェハ切断機・パッケージング装置・一般機械）には `false` を書く。** 継承レシピを持つ機械でも true にしてよい（EUV・ダイシングは継承レシピ＋品質モジュール）。速度・省エネ・生産性はこのキーと無関係に全機械で効く
  - `enum MachineSlotPlacementCheck { Allowed, RecipeNotSelected, ItemNotBoundToSlot, SlotBeyondRecipeOutputs, ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine }`
  - `VanillaMachineModuleInventory(int moduleSlotCount, bool allowQualityModule, BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent blockInventoryUpdate, BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId, int inputSlotSize, int outputSlotSize)`
  - `public bool VanillaMachineModuleInventory.IsModuleEffective(ModuleMasterElement module)`

- [ ] **Step 1: テストを書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleQualityRestrictionTest.cs`（新規ディレクトリ `Upgrade/` を作る。Part C のサーバーテストはここへまとめる）

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Game.PlayerInventory.Interface;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Server.Protocol.PacketResponse.Util.InventoryService;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールが allowQualityModule の機械にだけ置けて効くことを検証する
    ///     Verifies quality modules are placeable and effective only on machines with allowQualityModule
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineModuleQualityRestrictionTest
    {
        // TestElectricMachine（許可）と TestGearMachine（不許可）はどちらも入力2・出力3・モジュール4
        // TestElectricMachine (allowed) and TestGearMachine (disallowed) both have 2 inputs, 3 outputs and 4 module slots
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = 5;
        private const int PlayerId = 1;

        [Test]
        public void QualityModulePlacementFollowsMachinePermissionTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var gearInventory = PlaceInventory(ForUnitTestModBlockId.GearMachine, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var electricInventory = PlaceInventory(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, new Vector3Int(5, 1, 1));

            // 不許可機械は品質だけを拒否し、速度と非モジュールは従来どおり置ける
            // A disallowed machine refuses only quality; speed and non-module items stay placeable as before
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine, gearInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality)));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, gearInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed)));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, gearInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(ForUnitTestItemId.ItemId4, 1)));

            // 許可機械は品質を受け入れる
            // An allowed machine accepts quality
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed, electricInventory.CheckPlacement(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void QualityModuleMoveIntoDisallowedMachineIsRejectedTest()
        {
            var (_, serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var mainInventory = serviceProvider.GetService<IPlayerInventoryDataStore>().GetInventoryData(PlayerId).MainOpenableInventory;
            var gearInventory = PlaceInventory(ForUnitTestModBlockId.GearMachine, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var qualityModule = CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality);
            mainInventory.SetItem(0, qualityModule);

            // 移動は拒否され、モジュールはプレイヤー側に残る
            // The move is refused and the module stays with the player
            var result = InventoryItemMoveService.Move(mainInventory, 0, gearInventory, ModuleRangeStart, 1);
            Assert.AreEqual(InventoryItemMoveResult.RejectedByDestination, result);
            Assert.AreEqual(qualityModule.Id, mainInventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(ItemMaster.EmptyItemId, gearInventory.GetItem(ModuleRangeStart).Id);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DisallowedQualityModuleIsExcludedFromEffectTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.GearMachine, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            var inventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();

            // セーブ由来を模して判定を通さずに書き込んでも、効果にもトレードオフにも数えない
            // Even when written without the check (as a save would), it counts toward neither the effect nor its tradeoff
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModule(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality));
            var effect = block.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>().AggregateCurrent();
            Assert.AreEqual(0f, effect.QualityShift, 0.0001f);
            Assert.AreEqual(1f, effect.ProcessingTimeMultiplier, 0.0001f);
        }

        private static VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent PlaceInventory(BlockId blockId, Vector3Int position)
        {
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(blockId, position, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
        }

        private static IItemStack CreateModule(string effectAxis)
        {
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == effectAxis);
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(module.ItemGuid, 1);
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械スロットへの配置判定結果。拒否時はログで原因を区別できるよう理由ごとに値を分ける
    ///     Result of a machine slot placement check; rejections carry distinct reasons so logs can tell them apart
    /// </summary>
    public enum MachineSlotPlacementCheck
    {
        Allowed,
        RecipeNotSelected,
        ItemNotBoundToSlot,
        SlotBeyondRecipeOutputs,
        ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine,
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 5: モジュールインベントリに効き先の判定を持たせる**

`VanillaMachineModuleInventory.cs` 全体:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Event;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Event;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械のモジュールスロット（統合スロットの第3レンジ）
    ///     The machine's module slots (third range in unified numbering)
    /// </summary>
    public class VanillaMachineModuleInventory : IVanillaMachineSubInventory
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> ModuleSlot => _itemDataStoreService.InventoryItems;
        IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> IVanillaMachineSubInventory.Items => ModuleSlot;

        private readonly OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService _itemDataStoreService;
        private readonly bool _allowQualityModule;

        public VanillaMachineModuleInventory(
            int moduleSlotCount,
            bool allowQualityModule,
            BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEvent blockInventoryUpdate,
            BlockInstanceId blockInstanceId,
            int inputSlotSize,
            int outputSlotSize)
        {
            _allowQualityModule = allowQualityModule;
            _itemDataStoreService = new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService(InvokeEvent, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, moduleSlotCount);

            #region Internal

            void InvokeEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
            {
                // 第3レンジのためオフセットを加算して通知
                // Offset by the first two ranges when notifying
                blockInventoryUpdate.OnInventoryUpdateInvoke(new BlockOpenableInventoryUpdateEventProperties(
                    blockInstanceId, slot + inputSlotSize + outputSlotSize, itemStack));
            }

            #endregion
        }

        public void SetItem(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItem(slot, itemStack);
        }

        // 不許可の品質モジュールだけを拒否する。非モジュールは従来どおり置ける（効果集計が無視する）
        // Refuse only a disallowed quality module; non-module items stay placeable as before (the aggregation ignores them)
        public MachineSlotPlacementCheck CheckPlacement(int localSlot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            if (itemStack.Id == ItemMaster.EmptyItemId) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;
            var module = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetModuleByItemIdOrNull(itemStack.Id);
            if (module == null) return MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed;
            return IsModuleEffective(module) ? MachineSlotPlacementCheck.Allowed : MachineSlotPlacementCheck.ModuleNotAllowedOnMachine;
        }

        // この機械で効くモジュールか。品質は許可された機械だけで効く
        // Whether the module works on this machine; quality works only where allowed
        public bool IsModuleEffective(ModuleMasterElement module)
        {
            return _allowQualityModule || module.EffectAxis != ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality;
        }

        public void SetItemWithoutEvent(int slot, IItemStack itemStack)
        {
            _itemDataStoreService.SetItemWithoutEvent(slot, itemStack);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C2: レベル継承レシピの宣言と検証

機械レシピの必須キー `levelInheritance` を足し、継承元・継承先を引く util と検証を用意する。テストマスタに継承の最小例（別ファミリー間の継承・上限つき継承）を入れる。実行時の挙動は C3。

**Files:**
- Modify: `VanillaSchema/machineRecipes.yml`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/_CompileRequester.cs`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.cs`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidator.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineRecipesMasterUtil.cs:8-13`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests.Module/TestMod/ForUnitTest/mods/forUnitTest/master/machineRecipes.json`・`items.json`・`blocks.json`
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/ServerData/mods/EditModeInPlayingTestMod/master/machineRecipes.json`
- Modify（moorestech_master）: `server_v8/mods/moorestechAlphaMod_8/master/machineRecipes.json`
- Modify: `.moorestech-external-revisions.json`
- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests.Module/TestMod/ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.cs`
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Core/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidatorTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: なし（C1 の後に着手する。テストマスタの機械ブロックは C1 の必須キー `allowQualityModule` を持っている前提で、Step 6 の複製もそれを引き継ぐ）
- Produces（Part B・S2・Part D が使う宣言方法）:
  - スキーマ: 機械レシピの必須キー `"levelInheritance": "None" | "Inherit" | "InheritUpToUnlocked"`。生成定数は `MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.None` / `.Inherit` / `.InheritUpToUnlocked`、プロパティは `string MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritance`
  - 継承の規則（検証が強制する）: 継承レシピは「levelFamily の基準アイテムを指す入力」がちょうど1つ（継承元）、「levelFamily の基準アイテムを指す出力」がちょうど1つ（継承先）。継承元と継承先は別ファミリーでよい（GPU→GPU衛星）。継承先ファミリーの長さ ≥ 継承元ファミリーの長さ（等しくてよい）。同じ継承先ファミリーを指す継承レシピの間で `Inherit` と `InheritUpToUnlocked` を混ぜない。他の入力は levelFamily の基準であってはならない（固定素材はファミリーを持たないアイテムで書く）。他の出力は基準でなければ何でもよく、継承先と同じファミリーの非基準の変種やファミリー外のアイテムを並べてよい（ダイシングの出力「ダイ基準1つ＋ダイ Lv2..LvN＋失敗ダイ」はこの形で通る。`DicingShapedOutputsOnQualityMachinePassTest`）。機械の `allowQualityModule` は見ない（品質可の EUV・ダイシングにも継承レシピを置ける）
  - 実行時に継承レベルが移るのは継承先の出力1つだけ（C3）。他の出力は書いたアイテムのまま出て、Part B の書き換え器が必要なら差し替える
  - 使い分け: チップ製品（モジュール・GPU・GPU衛星）は `InheritUpToUnlocked`（初期上限 Lv1、C7 の研究で上げる）。ダイ→チップのパッケージングは `Inherit`（上限なし）
  - `public static class Core.Master.MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil`:
    - `const int NotInheritanceIndex = -1`
    - `bool IsInheritance(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`
    - `bool HasCraftCap(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`
    - `bool IsLevelFamilyBase(Guid itemGuid)`
    - `int GetSourceInputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承でなければ -1）
    - `int GetTargetOutputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承でなければ -1）
    - `Guid GetCraftCapKey(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承先出力の基準アイテムGUID）
    - `IReadOnlyList<ItemId> GetSourceVariants(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`
    - `int ResolveSourceLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, ItemId itemId)`（1始まり。継承元の変種でなければ 0）
    - `ItemId GetSourceVariant(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int level)`
    - `ItemId GetTargetVariant(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int level)`
    - `int GetMaxLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)`（継承元ファミリーの長さ）
  - テスト用 ID: `Tests.Module.TestMod.ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds`（下記 Step 1）

```csharp
using System.IO;
using Core.Master;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Core.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピの util と検証（継承元・継承先の数、ダイシング形の出力、上限モードの混在）を確かめる
    ///     Checks the inheritance util and validation (source/target counts, dicing-shaped outputs, mixed cap modes)
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidatorTest
    {
        private const string TestElectricMachineGuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001";

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
        }

        [Test]
        public void UtilResolvesSourceAndTargetTest()
        {
            var inherit = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var capped = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid);
            var plain = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data[0];

            // 継承元は入力0、継承先は出力0、レベルは変種の並び順で決まる
            // The source is input 0, the target is output 0, and the level follows the variant order
            Assert.AreEqual(0, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceInputIndex(inherit));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetTargetOutputIndex(inherit));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveSourceLevel(inherit, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveSourceLevel(inherit, ForUnitTestItemId.ItemId1));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2), MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetTargetVariant(inherit, 2));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetMaxLevel(inherit));

            // 上限の有無と鍵（継承先の基準GUID）
            // Cap presence and its key (the target's base GUID)
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.HasCraftCap(inherit));
            Assert.IsTrue(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.HasCraftCap(capped));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetCraftCapKey(capped));

            // 継承でないレシピは -1
            // A non-inheritance recipe yields -1
            Assert.IsFalse(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsInheritance(plain));
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.NotInheritanceIndex, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceInputIndex(plain));
        }

        [Test]
        public void TestMasterPassesValidationTest()
        {
            Assert.IsTrue(new MachineRecipesMaster(LoadJson()).Validate(out var logs), logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void TwoFamilySourcesFailTest()
        {
            var json = LoadJson();
            var recipe = FindRecipe(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid.ToString());

            // 2つ目の入力も継承元ファミリーの基準にすると継承元が2つになる
            // Making the second input another family base yields two sources
            recipe["inputItems"][1]["itemGuid"] = ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SourceBaseGuid.ToString();

            Assert.IsFalse(new MachineRecipesMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("must have exactly one level-family source input", logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DicingShapedOutputsOnQualityMachinePassTest()
        {
            var json = LoadJson();
            var recipe = FindRecipe(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid.ToString());

            // 品質可の機械（出力3）へ移し、出力を「継承先の基準＋継承先の Lv2＋ファミリー外」にする（ダイシングと同じ形）
            // Move it to the quality-enabled machine (3 outputs) with outputs "target base + target Lv2 + out-of-family" (the dicing shape)
            recipe["blockGuid"] = TestElectricMachineGuid;
            recipe["outputItems"] = JArray.Parse("[" +
                "{\"percent\": 1, \"count\": 1, \"itemGuid\": \"00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000021\"}," +
                "{\"percent\": 1, \"count\": 1, \"itemGuid\": \"00000000-0000-0000-c0de-000000000022\"}," +
                "{\"percent\": 1, \"count\": 1, \"itemGuid\": \"00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000002\"}]");

            Assert.IsTrue(new MachineRecipesMaster(json).Validate(out var logs), logs);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MixedCapModeForSameTargetFailsTest()
        {
            var json = LoadJson();
            var capped = FindRecipe(json, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid.ToString());

            // 上限つきレシピの継承先を上限なしレシピと同じファミリーにすると混在になる
            // Pointing the capped recipe at the uncapped recipe's family mixes the modes
            capped["outputItems"][0]["itemGuid"] = ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.TargetBaseGuid.ToString();

            Assert.IsFalse(new MachineRecipesMaster(json).Validate(out var logs));
            StringAssert.Contains("mixes Inherit and InheritUpToUnlocked", logs);
        }

        private static JObject LoadJson()
        {
            var path = Path.Combine(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory, "mods", "forUnitTest", "master", "machineRecipes.json");
            return JObject.Parse(File.ReadAllText(path));
        }

        private static JObject FindRecipe(JObject json, string recipeGuid)
        {
            foreach (var recipe in (JArray)json["data"])
            {
                if (recipe["machineRecipeGuid"].Value<string>() == recipeGuid) return (JObject)recipe;
            }
            Assert.Fail($"recipe not found: {recipeGuid}");
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: util を書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     レベル継承レシピの継承元入力・継承先出力を引く純関数。サーバーの束縛・実現出力・返却とクライアントの表示が共有する
    ///     Pure lookups for a level-inheritance recipe's source input and target output, shared by the server binding, outputs and refund and by the client display
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil
    {
        public const int NotInheritanceIndex = -1;

        public static bool IsInheritance(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return recipe.LevelInheritance != MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.None;
        }

        // 研究で上げる製作上限を見るレシピか
        // Whether the recipe obeys the research-raised craft cap
        public static bool HasCraftCap(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return recipe.LevelInheritance == MachineRecipeMasterElement.LevelInheritanceConst.InheritUpToUnlocked;
        }

        // levelFamily の基準アイテムか（変種や存在しないGUIDは false）
        // Whether the item is a level-family base (variants and unknown GUIDs are false)
        public static bool IsLevelFamilyBase(Guid itemGuid)
        {
            var itemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemIdOrNull(itemGuid);
            return itemId.HasValue && MasterHolder.ItemMaster.HasLevelFamily(itemId.Value);
        }

        // 継承元の入力番号。継承レシピでなければ -1
        // Index of the source input; -1 for a non-inheritance recipe
        public static int GetSourceInputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (!IsInheritance(recipe)) return NotInheritanceIndex;
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.InputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                if (IsLevelFamilyBase(recipe.InputItems[i].ItemGuid)) return i;
            }
            return NotInheritanceIndex;
        }

        // 継承先の出力番号。継承レシピでなければ -1
        // Index of the target output; -1 for a non-inheritance recipe
        public static int GetTargetOutputIndex(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            if (!IsInheritance(recipe)) return NotInheritanceIndex;
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.OutputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                if (IsLevelFamilyBase(recipe.OutputItems[i].ItemGuid)) return i;
            }
            return NotInheritanceIndex;
        }

        // 製作上限の鍵は継承先出力の基準アイテムGUID
        // The craft cap is keyed by the target output's base item GUID
        public static Guid GetCraftCapKey(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return recipe.OutputItems[GetTargetOutputIndex(recipe)].ItemGuid;
        }

        public static IReadOnlyList<ItemId> GetSourceVariants(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(SourceBaseItemId(recipe));
        }

        // 継承元ファミリーでのレベル（1始まり）。変種でなければ 0
        // Level within the source family (1-based); 0 when the item is not a variant
        public static int ResolveSourceLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var variants = GetSourceVariants(recipe);
            for (var i = 0; i < variants.Count; i++)
            {
                if (variants[i] == itemId) return i + 1;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public static ItemId GetSourceVariant(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int level)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(SourceBaseItemId(recipe), level);
        }

        public static ItemId GetTargetVariant(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int level)
        {
            var targetBaseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.OutputItems[GetTargetOutputIndex(recipe)].ItemGuid);
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(targetBaseItemId, level);
        }

        public static int GetMaxLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return GetSourceVariants(recipe).Count;
        }

        private static ItemId SourceBaseItemId(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.InputItems[GetSourceInputIndex(recipe)].ItemGuid);
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 検証を書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Core.Master/Validator/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidator.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Core.Master.Validator.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピの形（継承元1つ・継承先1つ・ファミリー長・上限モードの一貫性）を検証する。機械の品質可否は見ない
    ///     Validates an inheritance recipe's shape: one source, one target, family lengths and consistent cap modes; the machine's quality permission is not checked
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceValidator
    {
        public static string Validate(MachineRecipes machineRecipes)
        {
            var logs = "";
            var modeByTargetGuid = new Dictionary<Guid, string>();
            foreach (var recipe in machineRecipes.Data)
            {
                if (!MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsInheritance(recipe)) continue;
                logs += ValidateRecipe(recipe);
            }
            return logs;

            #region Internal

            string ValidateRecipe(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
            {
                var prefix = $"[MachineRecipesMaster] Recipe GUID:{recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} levelInheritance:{recipe.LevelInheritance}";

                // 継承元・継承先はちょうど1つずつ。数が合わなければ以降の判定ができない
                // Exactly one source and one target; later checks are meaningless otherwise
                var sourceCount = 0;
                foreach (var input in recipe.InputItems) if (MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsLevelFamilyBase(input.ItemGuid)) sourceCount++;
                var targetCount = 0;
                foreach (var output in recipe.OutputItems) if (MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsLevelFamilyBase(output.ItemGuid)) targetCount++;
                if (sourceCount != 1) return $"{prefix} must have exactly one level-family source input but has {sourceCount}\n";
                if (targetCount != 1) return $"{prefix} must have exactly one level-family target output but has {targetCount}\n";

                var errors = "";
                var targetBaseGuid = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetCraftCapKey(recipe);
                var targetLength = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariants(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(targetBaseGuid)).Count;
                var sourceLength = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetMaxLevel(recipe);
                if (targetLength < sourceLength) errors += $"{prefix} target family has {targetLength} levels but the source family has {sourceLength}\n";

                // 同じ継承先ファミリーで上限ありと上限なしを混ぜると、研究の効き方が経路で変わる
                // Mixing capped and uncapped recipes for one target family would make research apply per path
                if (modeByTargetGuid.TryGetValue(targetBaseGuid, out var knownMode) && knownMode != recipe.LevelInheritance)
                {
                    errors += $"{prefix} mixes Inherit and InheritUpToUnlocked for target family base {targetBaseGuid}\n";
                }
                modeByTargetGuid[targetBaseGuid] = recipe.LevelInheritance;
                return errors;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C3: 継承レシピの実行（入力束縛・実現出力・返却・待機キャッシュ）

継承元スロットが継承元ファミリーのどの変種も受け、入っていた変種のレベルで継承先を出す。待機中のキャッシュと加工中ジョブの返却も継承レベルを持つ。あわせて一般機械の汎用の品質シフト（品質モジュールで出力を上位変種へ抽選する経路）を撤去する。品質を読むのは Part B のチップ抽選の書き換え器だけになり、品質モジュールは一般機械の出力を変えない。セーブ・ロードをまたぐ保持は C4。

- Produces:

  - `public int ProcessingMachineProcessState.InheritedLevel { get; private set; }`（ジョブ無しは 1）
  - `public static List<IItemStack> MachineRecipeRefundUtil.CreateRefundStacks(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inheritedLevel)`

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承機械（入力2・出力2・モジュール4）を置いて回すための共通処理
    ///     Shared helpers to place and run the inheritance machine (2 inputs, 2 outputs, 4 module slots)
    /// </summary>
    public static class LevelInheritanceTestHelper
    {
        public const int InputSlotCount = 2;
        public const int OutputSlotCount = 2;
        public const int ModuleRangeStart = InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount;
        public static readonly Guid Test1ItemGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000001");

        public static (IBlock block, VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor) PlaceMachine(Vector3Int position)
        {
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.MachineId, position, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return (block, block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>(), block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>());
        }

        public static MachineRecipeMasterElement Recipe(Guid recipeGuid)
        {
            return MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(recipeGuid);
        }

        public static IItemStack Create(ItemId itemId, int count)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, count);
        }

        public static IItemStack CreateTest1(int count)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(Test1ItemGuid, count);
        }

        public static OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService CreateOverflow(int slotCount)
        {
            return new OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService((_, _) => { }, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory, slotCount);
        }

        // 毎tick有効要求電力ちょうどを供給して進める（電力比1.0で決定論化）
        // Advance supplying exactly the effective request power each tick (ratio 1.0 keeps it deterministic)
        public static void AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(int ticks, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < ticks; i++)
            {
                processor.SupplyExternalPower(processor.EffectiveRequestPower);
                GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            }
        }

        // レシピ1回分を開始から払い出しまで進めるtick数
        // Ticks to run one craft from start to payout
        public static int TicksToComplete(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            return (int)GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(recipe.Time) + 5;
        }

        // 指定範囲の指定アイテムの合計数
        // Total count of the item within the slot range
        public static int CountItem(IOpenableInventory inventory, int start, int end, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var total = 0;
            for (var i = start; i < end; i++)
            {
                var stack = inventory.GetItem(i);
                if (stack.Id == itemId) total += stack.Count;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Core.Item;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Context;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピが入力のレベルを別ファミリーの出力へ移し、混ぜず、返却・待機キャッシュでもレベルを保つことを検証する
    ///     Verifies an inheritance recipe carries the input level into another family's output, never mixes, and keeps the level in refunds and the idle cache
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceRecipeTest
    {
        [Test]
        public void InheritsSourceLevelAcrossFamiliesTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // Lv3 の継承元と固定素材を入れて1回分回す
            // Insert a Lv3 source plus the fixed input and run one craft
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);

            // 別ファミリーの Lv3 が出て、Lv1 は出ない
            // The other family's Lv3 comes out and no Lv1 does
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void SourceLevelsNeverMixInSlotTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));

            // Lv2 が入っている継承元スロットへ Lv3 は重ならず、全量が戻る
            // A Lv3 never stacks onto the Lv2 already in the source slot; the whole stack bounces back
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 1));
            var remainder = inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), remainder.Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, remainder.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), inventory.GetItem(0).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RecipeChangeRefundsInheritedLevelTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));

            // 加工開始（入力消費）まで進める
            // Advance until processing starts and the inputs are consumed
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(2, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, inventory.GetItem(0).Count);

            // 選択解除で返却され、継承元は Lv3 のまま戻る
            // Clearing the selection refunds the job and the source comes back as Lv3
            var overflow = CreateOverflow(10);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeSelectionResult.Success, processor.ClearSelectedRecipe(overflow));
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void IdleCacheFollowsSourceLevelChangeTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var recipe = Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);

            // 出力スロットを Lv1 で満杯にし、Lv2 の実現出力を待機中に確定させる
            // Fill the output slot with Lv1 so the Lv2 realized output is fixed while waiting
            var targetMax = ItemStackLevelDataStore.Instance.GetMaxStack(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(1));
            inventory.SetItem(InputSlotCount, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(1), targetMax));
            inventory.SetItem(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), 2));
            inventory.SetItem(1, CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(3, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);

            // 待機中に継承元を Lv3 へ差し替えてから出力を空ける
            // Swap the source to Lv3 while waiting, then free the output
            inventory.SetItem(0, Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(1, processor);
            inventory.SetItem(InputSlotCount, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(TicksToComplete(recipe), processor);

            // 古い Lv2 の確定結果を使い回さず、Lv3 が出る
            // The stale Lv2 result is not reused; Lv3 comes out
            Assert.AreEqual(1, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(3)));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountItem(inventory, InputSlotCount, InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Target(2)));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        // スロットslotIndexが素材itemIdの束縛先か。継承元スロットは継承元ファミリーのどの変種も受ける
        // Whether slot slotIndex is bound to input itemId; the source slot accepts any variant of the source family
        public static bool IsInputBoundTo(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int slotIndex, ItemId itemId)
        {
            if (slotIndex < 0 || recipe.InputItems.Length <= slotIndex) return false;
            if (slotIndex == MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceInputIndex(recipe)) return MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.ResolveSourceLevel(recipe, itemId) >= 1;
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.InputItems[slotIndex].ItemGuid) == itemId;
        }
```

```csharp
        // Resolve the inherited level from the source slot's item; 1 for non-inheritance recipes
        public int ResolveInheritedLevel(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
```

`MachineOutputFactoryUtil.cs` 全体を置き換える（`RollQualityLevel`・`CreateLevelAppliedOutputs`・`ApplyLevel` と `using System;` を削除）:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Fluid;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.Util
{
    internal static class MachineOutputFactoryUtil
    {
        // 素の出力1セットと、生産性の当選時に同じ1セットを追加で作る。品質は一般機械の出力を変えない
        // Build one plain output set plus an identical extra set when productivity rolls; quality never changes general machine output
        public static List<IItemStack> CreateRealizedOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, MachineModuleEffect effect, int inheritedLevel)
        {
            var outputs = CreatePlainOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel);
            if (GameRandom.NextDouble() < effect.ExtraOutputChance) outputs.AddRange(CreatePlainOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel));
            return outputs;
        }

        // レシピの液体出力1セットを生成
        // Build one set of the recipe's fluid outputs
        public static List<FluidStack> CreateFluidOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            var outputs = new List<FluidStack>(recipe.OutputFluids.Length);
            foreach (var outputFluid in recipe.OutputFluids)
            {
                var fluidId = MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(outputFluid.FluidGuid);
                outputs.Add(new FluidStack(outputFluid.Amount, fluidId));
            }
            return outputs;
        }

        // 出力1セットを書いたアイテムのまま作る。継承レシピは継承先の出力だけを継承レベルの変種にする
        // Build one output set as written; an inheritance recipe swaps only the target output to the inherited level's variant
        private static List<IItemStack> CreatePlainOutputs(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inheritedLevel)
        {
            // 継承レシピでなければ -1 なので、どの出力も書いたまま
            // -1 for a non-inheritance recipe, so every output stays as written
            var targetIndex = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetTargetOutputIndex(recipe);
            var outputs = new List<IItemStack>(recipe.OutputItems.Length);
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.OutputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                var output = recipe.OutputItems[i];
                var itemId = i == targetIndex ? MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetTargetVariant(recipe, inheritedLevel) : MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(output.ItemGuid);
                outputs.Add(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, output.Count));
            }
            return outputs;
        }
    }
}
```

`IdleMachineProcessState.cs` 全体:

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.Util;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State
{
    // 待機ステート。レシピが揃えば加工ジョブを確定し加工へ遷移する
    // Idle state: fixes the processing job and transitions to processing once a recipe is ready
    internal class IdleMachineProcessState : IMachineProcessState
    {
        private readonly MachineProcessContext _context;
        private readonly ProcessingMachineProcessState _processingState;

        // 出力先が空くのを待つ間、確定済みの実現出力を保持する（レシピか継承レベルが変わるまで再抽選しない）
        // Holds the already-realized outputs while waiting for output space (never re-rolled until the recipe or inherited level changes)
        private MachineRecipeMasterElement _pendingRecipe;
        private int _pendingInheritedLevel;
        private List<IItemStack> _pendingOutputs;

        public IdleMachineProcessState(MachineProcessContext context, ProcessingMachineProcessState processingState)
        {
            _context = context;
            _processingState = processingState;
        }

        public ProcessState State => ProcessState.Idle;
        public void OnEnter() { }
        public void OnExit() { }

        public ProcessState GetNextUpdate()
        {
            // 選択レシピが無ければ加工しない（レシピ選択必須）
            // Never process without a selected recipe (selection is mandatory)
            var recipe = _context.SelectedRecipe;
            if (recipe == null || !_context.InputInventory.IsAllowedToStartProcess(recipe))
            {
                ClearPendingOutputs();
                return ProcessState.Idle;
            }

            // レシピか継承レベルが変わったときだけ新規に確定する。同じ組で待機している間は既存の実現結果を使い回す
            // Realize anew only when the recipe or inherited level changed; while waiting on the same pair, reuse the result
            var inheritedLevel = _context.InputInventory.ResolveInheritedLevel(recipe);
            if (_pendingRecipe != recipe || _pendingInheritedLevel != inheritedLevel)
            {
                _pendingOutputs = _context.CreateRealizedOutputs(recipe, inheritedLevel);
                _pendingRecipe = recipe;
                _pendingInheritedLevel = inheritedLevel;
            }

            if (!_context.OutputInventory.CanStoreOutputs(_pendingOutputs, MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateFluidOutputs(recipe)))
            {
                return ProcessState.Idle;
            }

            // ProcessingStateへ遷移
            // Hand the job to ProcessingState and transition
            _processingState.SetProcessing(recipe, _pendingOutputs, inheritedLevel);
            ClearPendingOutputs();
            return ProcessState.Processing;

            #region Internal

            void ClearPendingOutputs()
            {
                _pendingRecipe = null;
                _pendingInheritedLevel = 0;
                _pendingOutputs = null;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 加工中ジョブに継承レベルを持たせる**

`ProcessingMachineProcessState.cs` 全体:

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State.Util;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Util;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.State
{
    // 加工ステート。電力に応じて進行し、完了で待機へ戻る
    // Processing state: advances with power and returns to idle on completion
    internal class ProcessingMachineProcessState : IMachineProcessState
    {
        // 進行中レシピ(返却用)。無ければnull
        // Recipe of the running job (for refund calculation); null when no job exists
        public MachineRecipeMasterElement CurrentRecipe { get; private set; }

        // 進行中ジョブの継承レベル。継承レシピ以外とジョブ無しは1（返却とセーブが使う）
        // Inherited level of the running job; 1 for non-inheritance recipes or no job (used by refunds and saves)
        public int InheritedLevel { get; private set; } = 1;

        public ProcessState State => ProcessState.Processing;
        private readonly MachineProcessContext _context;
        public Guid RecipeGuid => CurrentRecipe?.MachineRecipeGuid ?? Guid.Empty;

        public uint TotalTicks { get; private set; }
        public uint RemainingTicks  { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyList<IItemStack> PendingOutputs => _pendingOutputs;
        private List<IItemStack> _pendingOutputs;

        // 完了直前に産出リストを差し替えるフック（清浄室のチップ抽選など、OnExit挿入前の置き換え用）
        // Hook to replace the pending output list just before completion (e.g. clean-room chip draw swaps items before OnExit inserts them)
        public void ReplacePendingOutputs(List<IItemStack> outputs)
        {
            _pendingOutputs = outputs;
        }

        // 出力を払い出さずジョブを破棄(返却用)
        // Discard the job without paying outputs (used by the recipe-change refund flow)
        public void CancelProcessing()
        {
            ClearJob();
        }

        public ProcessingMachineProcessState(MachineProcessContext context, uint remainingTicks, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int inheritedLevel)
        {
            _context = context;
            RemainingTicks = remainingTicks;

            // レシピがあれば加工を復元する。産出予定nullの旧セーブは完了時に再抽選する
            // Restore processing whenever a recipe exists; old saves with null pending outputs re-roll on completion
            if (recipe != null)
            {
                SetProcessing(recipe, pendingOutputs, inheritedLevel);
            }
        }

        // 加工するジョブをIdle、ロードから設定
        // Set the processing job from Idle or on load
        public void SetProcessing(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int inheritedLevel)
        {
            // 継承レベル0以下はセーブ破損かマイグレーション漏れなので、黙って補わずに止める
            // A level of 0 or less means a corrupt save or a missed migration, so stop instead of silently filling it in
            if (inheritedLevel < 1) throw new InvalidOperationException($"加工ジョブの継承レベルが不正です recipe={recipe.MachineRecipeGuid} inheritedLevel={inheritedLevel}");

            CurrentRecipe = recipe;
            InheritedLevel = inheritedLevel;
            _pendingOutputs = pendingOutputs;

            var effect = _context.EffectComponent.AggregateCurrent();
            var baseTicks = GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(recipe.Time);
            var totalTicks = (uint)Math.Max(1, (long)Math.Round(baseTicks * effect.ProcessingTimeMultiplier));
            TotalTicks = totalTicks;
        }

        // 開始時に入力を消費し残りtickを設定する
        // Consume inputs and set remaining ticks on start
        public void OnEnter()
        {
            _context.InputInventory.ReduceInputSlot(CurrentRecipe);
            RemainingTicks = TotalTicks;
        }

        public ProcessState GetNextUpdate()
        {
            // 電力、モジュールに基づいてこのティックで引くティック数を計算
            // Calculate the number of ticks to consume this tick based on power and modules
            var effectiveRequestPower = _context.EffectiveRequestPower(ProcessState.Processing);
            var subTicks = MachineCurrentPowerToSubSecond.GetSubTicks(_context.CurrentPower, effectiveRequestPower);

            if (0 < RemainingTicks)
            {
                // 残りtickが尽きるまでは加工継続
                // Keep processing until remaining ticks run out
                if (subTicks < RemainingTicks)
                {
                    RemainingTicks -= subTicks;
                    return ProcessState.Processing;
                }
                RemainingTicks = 0;
            }

            // 旧セーブで産出予定が無い場合はここで一度だけ確定させる（以後の保留tickで再抽選しないため）
            // Old saves lacking pending outputs get rolled once here (so held ticks afterward never re-roll)
            _pendingOutputs ??= _context.CreateRealizedOutputs(CurrentRecipe, InheritedLevel);

            // tickは尽きたが産出物が収まらない間は、加工ではなく出力詰まりとして待つ（要求電力を待機率へ落とす）
            // Once ticks are exhausted but the outputs do not fit, wait as output-blocked rather than processing (drops the request to the idle rate)
            if (!CanStoreRealizedOutputs()) return ProcessState.OutputBlocked;

            return ProcessState.Idle;
        }

        // 確定済み産出物が出力先へ収まるか。出力詰まりステートの復帰判定と共有する
        // Whether the fixed outputs fit; shared with the output-blocked state's resume decision
        public bool CanStoreRealizedOutputs()
        {
            if (CurrentRecipe == null) return true;
            return _context.OutputInventory.CanStoreOutputs(_pendingOutputs, MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateFluidOutputs(CurrentRecipe));
        }

        // 完了時に産出物を払い出す。詰まっている間は保持したまま出力詰まりステートへ引き継ぐ
        // Pay the outputs on completion; while blocked the job stays held and is handed to the output-blocked state
        public void OnExit()
        {
            if (!CanStoreRealizedOutputs()) return;
            PayoutAndClear();
        }

        // 産出物を払い出してジョブを空にする（旧セーブは産出予定が無いため再抽選）
        // Pay the outputs and empty the job (re-roll for old saves that lack pending outputs)
        public void PayoutAndClear()
        {
            if (CurrentRecipe == null) return;

            var outputs = _pendingOutputs ?? _context.CreateRealizedOutputs(CurrentRecipe, InheritedLevel);
            _context.OutputInventory.InsertOutputSlot(outputs, MachineOutputFactoryUtil.CreateFluidOutputs(CurrentRecipe));

            // 加工情報をクリアしてIdleが古いレシピ/進捗を報告・保存しないようにする
            // Clear the processing snapshot so idle does not report or serialize stale recipe/progress
            ClearJob();
        }

        private void ClearJob()
        {
            _pendingOutputs = null;
            CurrentRecipe = null;
            InheritedLevel = 1;
            TotalTicks = 0;
            RemainingTicks = 0;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
        // 返却対象のアイテム材料を生成する（isRemainは消費されていないため対象外）。継承元は投入時のレベルで返す
        // Build the item stacks to refund (isRemain inputs are not consumed, so excluded); the source returns at its input level
        public static List<IItemStack> CreateRefundStacks(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, int inheritedLevel)
        {
            var sourceIndex = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceInputIndex(recipe);
            var stacks = new List<IItemStack>();
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.InputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                var input = recipe.InputItems[i];
                if (input.IsRemain.HasValue && input.IsRemain.Value) continue;
                var itemId = i == sourceIndex ? MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceVariant(recipe, inheritedLevel) : MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(input.ItemGuid);
                stacks.Add(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(itemId, input.Count));
            }
            return stacks;
        }
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Item.Interface;
using Core.Master;
using Core.Update;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールが一般機械の出力を変えないことと、レベル変種の出力がセーブをまたいで残ることを確かめる
    ///     Verifies quality modules leave general machine output unchanged and level-variant outputs survive a save
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelVariantOutputTest
    {
        // テスト用機械のスロット構成（blocks.jsonのTestElectricMachineに対応）
        // Slot layout of the test machine (matches TestElectricMachine in blocks.json)
        private const int InputSlotCount = 2;
        private const int OutputSlotCount = 3;
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount;

        [Test]
        public void QualityModuleLeavesGeneralOutputAtBaseLevelTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));

            var recipe = GetMachineRecipe();
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var quality = GetModuleOfAxis(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality);
            var productivity = GetModuleOfAxis(ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Productivity);
            Assert.GreaterOrEqual(productivity.EffectValue, 1f, "生産性の追加産出が確定でない（前提が崩れている）");

            // 品質と生産性を付けて1サイクル回す（時間は両トレードオフの合算で延びる）
            // Run one cycle with quality and productivity (time stretches by both tradeoffs)
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, CreateModuleItem(quality));
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart + 1, CreateModuleItem(productivity));
            InsertRecipeInputs(block, inventory, recipe);
            var ticks = (int)Math.Round(GameUpdater.SecondsToTicks(recipe.Time) * (1f + quality.TradeoffValue + productivity.TradeoffValue));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(1 + ticks + 3, processor);

            // 出力は基準アイテム2セットで、上位変種は1つも無い
            // The output is two sets of the base item with no higher variant at all
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Idle, processor.CurrentState);
            var (baseItemId, lv2ItemId) = GetBaseAndLv2ItemIds(recipe);
            Assert.AreEqual(recipe.OutputItems[0].Count * 2, CountOutputItem(inventory, baseItemId));
            Assert.AreEqual(0, CountOutputItem(inventory, lv2ItemId));
        }

        [Test]
        public void VariantOutputSaveLoadTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));

            var recipe = GetMachineRecipe();
            var (block, inventory, _) = PlaceMachine(new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1));
            var (_, lv2ItemId) = GetBaseAndLv2ItemIds(recipe);

            // 束縛(ADR 0042)のため、出力スロットへ置く前にレシピを選択してから変種を置いてセーブする
            // Binding (ADR 0042) needs the recipe selected first; then place the variant and save
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);
            inventory.SetItem(InputSlotCount, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(lv2ItemId, 7));
            var saveState = block.GetSaveState();

            // ロード後も変種ItemIdと数量が残る
            // The variant ItemId and count survive the load
            var blockGuid = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId).BlockGuid;
            var loadedBlock = ServerContext.BlockFactory.Load(blockGuid, new BlockInstanceId(301), saveState, block.BlockPositionInfo);
            var loadedInventory = loadedBlock.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(lv2ItemId, loadedInventory.GetItem(InputSlotCount).Id);
            Assert.AreEqual(7, loadedInventory.GetItem(InputSlotCount).Count);
        }

        private static (IBlock block, VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor) PlaceMachine(Vector3Int position)
        {
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, position, BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            return (block, block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>(), block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>());
        }

        private static MachineRecipeMasterElement GetMachineRecipe()
        {
            var machineBlockGuid = MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId).BlockGuid;
            return MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data.First(r => r.BlockGuid == machineBlockGuid);
        }

        // 出力の基準ItemIdとLv2変種ItemId（ファミリーがある前提も確かめる）
        // The output's base and Lv2 variant ItemIds (also asserts the family exists)
        private static (ItemId baseItemId, ItemId lv2ItemId) GetBaseAndLv2ItemIds(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            var baseItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(recipe.OutputItems[0].ItemGuid);
            Assert.IsTrue(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.HasLevelFamily(baseItemId));
            var lv2ItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetLevelVariantItemId(baseItemId, 2);
            Assert.AreNotEqual(baseItemId, lv2ItemId);
            return (baseItemId, lv2ItemId);
        }

        private static void InsertRecipeInputs(IBlock block, VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe)
        {
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, recipe);
            foreach (var inputItem in recipe.InputItems)
            {
                inventory.InsertItem(ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(inputItem.ItemGuid, inputItem.Count));
            }
        }

        // 毎tick有効要求電力ちょうどを供給して進める（電力比1.0で確率的丸めを排除する）
        // Advance ticks supplying exactly the effective request power (ratio 1.0 removes probabilistic rounding)
        private static void AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(int ticks, VanillaMachineProcessorComponent processor)
        {
            for (var i = 0; i < ticks; i++)
            {
                processor.SupplyExternalPower(processor.EffectiveRequestPower);
                GameUpdater.UpdateOneTick();
            }
        }

        private static ModuleMasterElement GetModuleOfAxis(string effectAxis)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == effectAxis);
        }

        private static IItemStack CreateModuleItem(ModuleMasterElement moduleElement)
        {
            return ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(moduleElement.ItemGuid), 1);
        }

        private static int CountOutputItem(VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent inventory, ItemId itemId)
        {
            var total = 0;
            for (var i = InputSlotCount; i < InputSlotCount + OutputSlotCount; i++)
            {
                var stack = inventory.GetItem(i);
                if (stack.Id == itemId) total += stack.Count;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C4: 継承レベルの保存と V6→V7 マイグレーション

加工中ジョブの継承レベルを両プロセッサのセーブへ載せ、旧セーブには `inheritedLevel: 1` を足すマイグレーションを入れる（セーブ形式の変更。AGENTS.md の3点セット）。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/VanillaMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/VanillaMachineProcessorComponent.cs:45,51-52,56,63,183-197`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Factory/BlockTemplate/BlockTemplateUtil.cs:168-178`
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveJsonObject.cs`

- Create: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SaveLoad/Migration/Steps/SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C3 の `ProcessingMachineProcessState.InheritedLevel`・5引数コンストラクタ
- Produces:
  - `WorldSaveAllInfo.CurrentVersion == 7`、`SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7 : ISaveMigrationStep`（`FromVersion => 6`）
  - セーブ JSON: `state["Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent"]["processor"]["inheritedLevel"]`、`state["Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent"]["inheritedLevel"]`（int、1 以上）
  - `VanillaMachineProcessorComponent(VanillaMachineInputInventory input, VanillaMachineOutputInventory output, ProcessState currentState, uint remainingTicks, MachineRecipeMasterElement processingRecipe, float requestPower, float idlePowerRate, MachineModuleEffectComponent effect, List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, int processingInheritedLevel, MachineRecipeMasterElement selectedRecipe)`
  - `CleanRoomMachineProcessorSaveState.Restore(..., out List<IItemStack> pendingOutputs, out int inheritedLevel, out uint cycleCount, out MachineRecipeMasterElement selectedRecipe)`
  - **Part B へ**: B2 がクリーンルーム機械の液体の保存で版 7→8（`SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8`・`FromVersion => 7`・`CurrentVersion = 8`）を足す。Part A はセーブ形式を変えないので、本タスクの番号は 6→7 で確定

- [ ] **Step 1: マイグレーションのテストを書く**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/SaveLoad/SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7Test.cs`

```csharp
using Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.SaveLoad
{
    public class SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7Test
    {
        private const string VanillaKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent";
        private const string CleanRoomKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";

        [Test]
        public void 通常機械とクリーンルーム機械に継承レベル1が入り他のキーは残るTest()
        {
            var vanilla = JObject.Parse("{\"inputSlot\":[],\"processor\":{\"state\":1,\"remainingSeconds\":0.5,\"recipeGuid\":\"r\"}}");
            var cleanRoom = JObject.Parse("{\"cycleCount\":3,\"state\":0}");
            var save = Save(
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [VanillaKey] = vanilla } },
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [CleanRoomKey] = cleanRoom } });

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            var migratedVanilla = (JObject)result.Save["world"][0]["state"][VanillaKey];
            Assert.AreEqual(1, migratedVanilla["processor"]["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual(1, migratedVanilla["processor"]["state"].Value<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual("r", migratedVanilla["processor"]["recipeGuid"].Value<string>());
            var migratedCleanRoom = (JObject)result.Save["world"][1]["state"][CleanRoomKey];
            Assert.AreEqual(1, migratedCleanRoom["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual(3, migratedCleanRoom["cycleCount"].Value<int>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void 既に継承レベルを持つものと機械以外は素通しされるTest()
        {
            var save = Save(
                JObject.Parse($"{{\"state\":{{\"{VanillaKey}\":{{\"processor\":{{\"inheritedLevel\":3}}}}}}}}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"state\":{\"ChestComponent\":{\"items\":[]}}}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"z\"}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"state\":null}"));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, result.Save["world"][0]["state"][VanillaKey]["processor"]["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            Assert.IsNull(result.Save["world"][1]["state"]["ChestComponent"]["inheritedLevel"]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void processorがオブジェクトでなければ失敗するTest()
        {
            var save = Save(JObject.Parse($"{{\"state\":{{\"{VanillaKey}\":{{\"processor\":5}}}}}}"));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsFalse(result.IsConverted);
            StringAssert.Contains("processor", result.FailureReason);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 変換元の版は6Test()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(6, new SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7().FromVersion);
        }

        private static JObject Save(params JObject[] blocks)
        {
            return new JObject { ["worldVersion"] = 6, ["world"] = new JArray(blocks) };
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.IO;
using Core.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Paths;
using Game.SaveLoad.Interface;
using Game.SaveLoad.Json;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.CombinedTest.Game;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade.LevelInheritanceTestHelper;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     加工中ジョブの継承レベルがセーブ・ロードで保たれ、版6のセーブは継承レベル1で読めることを検証する
    ///     Verifies the running job's inherited level survives save/load and a version-6 save loads with level 1
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceSaveLoadTest
    {
        private static readonly Vector3Int MachinePosition = new(1, 1, 1);
        private const string VanillaKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent";
        private string _archiveRoot;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            _archiveRoot = SaveLoadPreparerTestFixture.ArchiveRootForThisRun();
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(_archiveRoot)) Directory.Delete(_archiveRoot, true);
        }

        [Test]
        public void InheritedLevelSurvivesSaveLoadTest()
        {
            var saveJson = BuildProcessingSave().ToString();

            // 別コンテナへロードし、選択解除の返却が Lv3 であることを見る
            // Load into a fresh container and check the clear-selection refund is Lv3
            var (_, loadProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            (loadProvider.GetService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>() as WorldLoaderFromJson).Load(saveJson);
            var overflow = RefundAfterLoad();
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Version6SaveLoadsWithInheritedLevelOneTest()
        {
            // 継承レベルを消して版6と名乗らせ、ファイル経由でマイグレーション連鎖を通す
            // Strip the level, label it version 6 and load from a file so the migration chain runs
            var save = BuildProcessingSave();
            Assert.IsTrue(((JObject)FindMachine(save)["state"][VanillaKey]["processor"]).Remove("inheritedLevel"));
            save["worldVersion"] = 6;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_archiveRoot);
            var sourcePath = WorldDataDirectory.FromWorldRoot(_archiveRoot).SaveJsonFilePath;
            File.WriteAllText(sourcePath, save.ToString());
            var options = new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory)
            {
                worldDataDirectory = WorldDataDirectory.FromServerDataMap(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory, sourcePath),
            };
            var (_, loadProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(options);
            loadProvider.GetRequiredService<IWorldSaveDataLoader>().LoadOrInitialize();

            // 加工中のまま読め、返却は Lv1（版6に継承レシピは無かった）
            // It loads still processing and refunds Lv1 (version 6 had no inheritance recipes)
            var processor = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(MachinePosition).GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>();
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);
            var overflow = RefundAfterLoad();
            Assert.AreEqual(2, CountItem(overflow, 0, 10, ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1)));
        }

        // Lv3 で加工中の継承機械を持つ現行セーブを作る
        // Build a current save holding the inheritance machine mid-job at Lv3
        private static JObject BuildProcessingSave()
        {
            var (_, provider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var (block, inventory, processor) = PlaceMachine(MachinePosition);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(block, Recipe(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid));
            inventory.InsertItem(Create(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3), 2));
            inventory.InsertItem(CreateTest1(1));
            AdvanceTicksWithFullPower(2, processor);
            Assert.AreEqual(ProcessState.Processing, processor.CurrentState);

            var save = JObject.Parse(provider.GetService<AssembleSaveJsonText>().AssembleSaveJson());
            Assert.AreEqual(3, FindMachine(save)["state"][VanillaKey]["processor"]["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            return save;
        }

        private static OpenableInventoryItemDataStoreService RefundAfterLoad()
        {
            var processor = ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.GetBlock(MachinePosition).GetComponent<VanillaMachineProcessorComponent>();
            var overflow = CreateOverflow(10);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeSelectionResult.Success, processor.ClearSelectedRecipe(overflow));
            return overflow;
        }

        private static JObject FindMachine(JObject save)
        {
            foreach (var block in (JArray)save["world"])
            {
                if (block["X"].Value<int>() == MachinePosition.x && block["Y"].Value<int>() == MachinePosition.y && block["Z"].Value<int>() == MachinePosition.z) return (JObject)block;
            }
            Assert.Fail($"セーブに {MachinePosition} のブロックがありません");
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: マイグレーションを書いて登録する**

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.SaveLoad/Migration/Steps/SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7.cs`

```csharp
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps
{
    // V6→V7移行: 通常機械とクリーンルーム機械の加工状態に継承レベル1を足す（版6に継承レシピは無いため1が正しい）
    // V6→V7 migration: add inherited level 1 to normal and clean-room machine processing state (version 6 had no inheritance recipes, so 1 is exact)
    public sealed class SaveMigrationStepV6ToV7 : ISaveMigrationStep
    {
        // コンポーネントのSaveKey(typeof FullName)。ステップは現行の型を参照しないので文字列で持つ
        // Component SaveKeys (typeof FullName); the step never references live types, so they are kept as strings
        private const string VanillaMachineSaveKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.VanillaMachineSaveComponent";
        private const string CleanRoomMachineSaveKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";
        private const string InheritedLevelKey = "inheritedLevel";

        public int FromVersion => 6;

        public SaveMigrationStepResult Migrate(JObject save)
        {
            if (!(save["world"] is JArray world)) return Fail($"セーブのworldが配列ではないため変換できません。 type={save["world"]?.Type}");

            var vanillaCount = 0;
            var cleanRoomCount = 0;
            foreach (var blockToken in world)
            {
                if (!(blockToken is JObject block)) return Fail($"world要素がオブジェクトではないため変換できません。 type={blockToken.Type}");

                // stateが無いブロックは機械ではないので対象外
                // A block without state is not a machine, so it is out of scope
                var stateToken = block["state"];
                if (stateToken == null || stateToken.Type == JTokenType.Null) continue;
                if (!(stateToken is JObject state)) return Fail($"world要素のstateがオブジェクトではありません。 type={stateToken.Type}");

                // 通常機械はprocessorサブオブジェクトへ足す
                // A normal machine gets the key inside its processor sub-object
                var vanillaToken = state[VanillaMachineSaveKey];
                if (vanillaToken != null && vanillaToken.Type != JTokenType.Null)
                {
                    if (!(vanillaToken is JObject vanilla) || !(vanilla["processor"] is JObject processor)) return Fail($"{VanillaMachineSaveKey} の processor がオブジェクトではありません。 type={vanillaToken["processor"]?.Type}");
                    if (processor[InheritedLevelKey] == null)
                    {
                        processor[InheritedLevelKey] = 1;
                        vanillaCount++;
                    }
                }

                // クリーンルーム機械は直下へ足す
                // A clean-room machine gets the key at its top level
                var cleanRoomToken = state[CleanRoomMachineSaveKey];
                if (cleanRoomToken != null && cleanRoomToken.Type != JTokenType.Null)
                {
                    if (!(cleanRoomToken is JObject cleanRoom)) return Fail($"{CleanRoomMachineSaveKey} がオブジェクトではありません。 type={cleanRoomToken.Type}");
                    if (cleanRoom[InheritedLevelKey] == null)
                    {
                        cleanRoom[InheritedLevelKey] = 1;
                        cleanRoomCount++;
                    }
                }
            }

            Debug.Log($"セーブを版6から版7へ変換しました。継承レベルを足した通常機械={vanillaCount}台 クリーンルーム機械={cleanRoomCount}台");
            return SaveMigrationStepResult.Converted(save);

            #region Internal

            SaveMigrationStepResult Fail(string failureReason)
            {
                // 直接実行した場合も拒否理由を残す
                // Preserve the refusal reason even when the step is called directly
                Debug.LogWarning($"セーブを版6から版7へ変換できません: {failureReason}");
                return SaveMigrationStepResult.Failed(failureReason);
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C5: Part B 向けの品質モジュール API（最高 tier と効果合計）

Part B の成膜（グレード上限＝最高 tier＋1）・EUV・ダイシング（品質効果による低減）が、機械から「装着中の品質モジュールの最高 tier」と「品質効果の合計」を取り出せるようにする。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/Machine/Module/MachineModuleEffect.cs`
- Test: `moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/CombinedTest/Core/Machine/Upgrade/MachineModuleQualityTierTest.cs`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C1 の効果集計（不許可モジュールの除外）
- Produces（Part B が使う）:
  - `public readonly int MachineModuleEffect.HighestQualityModuleTier`（効いている品質モジュールの `ModuleMasterElement.Tier` の最大。品質モジュールが無ければ 0）
  - `public readonly float MachineModuleEffect.QualityShift`（既存。効いている品質モジュールの `effectValue × 個数` の合計、下限 0。C6 以降は個数がスロットのスタック上限で頭打ちになる）
  - 取り出し口: `MachineModuleEffect MachineModuleEffectComponent.AggregateCurrent()`（ブロックの `GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>()`、またはプロセッサ内では `MachineProcessContext.EffectComponent`）
  - **Part D へ**: モジュール Lv1〜5 はレベルごとの別アイテムなので、items.json の `modules` にはレベルごとに1件ずつ書き、`tier` にそのレベル（1〜5）を入れる

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Inventory;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine.Module;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.Context;
using Mooresmaster.Model.ItemsModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using UnityEngine;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.Machine.Upgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     品質モジュールの最高 tier と効果合計が機械から取り出せることを検証する
    ///     Verifies the highest quality-module tier and the summed quality effect are readable from a machine
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineModuleQualityTierTest
    {
        // TestElectricMachine は品質可・入力2・出力3・モジュール4
        // TestElectricMachine allows quality and has 2 inputs, 3 outputs and 4 module slots
        private const int ModuleRangeStart = 5;

        [Test]
        public void AggregateReportsHighestQualityTierTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var tier1 = QualityModuleOfTier(1);
            var tier2 = QualityModuleOfTier(2);
            var speed = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Speed);

            // tier1×1 と tier2×2 なら最高は2、合計は個数加重
            // tier1 x1 plus tier2 x2 gives highest 2 and a count-weighted sum
            var effect = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> { new(tier1, 1), new(tier2, 2) });
            Assert.AreEqual(2, effect.HighestQualityModuleTier);
            Assert.AreEqual(tier1.EffectValue + tier2.EffectValue * 2, effect.QualityShift, 0.0001f);

            // 品質モジュールが無ければ0
            // Zero without any quality module
            var speedOnly = MachineModuleEffect.Aggregate(new List<MachineModuleEffect.EquippedModule> { new(speed, 1) });
            Assert.AreEqual(0, speedOnly.HighestQualityModuleTier);
        }

        [Test]
        public void MachineComponentExposesHighestQualityTierTest()
        {
            new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            ServerContext.WorldBlockDatastore.TryAddBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.MachineId, new Vector3Int(1, 1, 1), BlockDirection.North, Array.Empty<BlockCreateParam>(), out var block);
            var inventory = block.GetComponent<VanillaMachineBlockInventoryComponent>();
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(QualityModuleOfTier(1).ItemGuid, 1));
            inventory.SetItem(ModuleRangeStart + 1, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.Create(QualityModuleOfTier(2).ItemGuid, 1));

            var effect = block.GetComponent<MachineModuleEffectComponent>().AggregateCurrent();
            Assert.AreEqual(2, effect.HighestQualityModuleTier);
        }

        private static ModuleMasterElement QualityModuleOfTier(int tier)
        {
            return MasterHolder.ItemMaster.Items.Modules.First(m => m.EffectAxis == ModuleMasterElement.EffectAxisConst.Quality && m.Tier == tier);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C6: モジュールスロットのスタック上限（サーバー）
