```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using MessagePack;
using UniRx;

namespace Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     モジュールスロットのスタック上限レベルの変化を全プレイヤーへ配信する
    ///     Broadcasts module-slot stack limit level changes to every player
    /// </summary>
    public class ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket : IBootInitializable
    {
        public const string EventTag = "va:event:moduleSlotStackLevel";

        private readonly EventProtocolProvider _eventProtocolProvider;
        private readonly IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup _stackLimitLookup;

        public ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket(EventProtocolProvider eventProtocolProvider, IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup stackLimitLookup)
        {
            _eventProtocolProvider = eventProtocolProvider;
            _stackLimitLookup = stackLimitLookup;
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            // 上限の変化を購読し、変化後のレベルを配信する
            // Subscribe to limit changes and broadcast the level after the change
            _stackLimitLookup.OnStackLimitChanged.Subscribe(_ =>
            {
                var payload = MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack(_stackLimitLookup.CurrentLevel));
                _eventProtocolProvider.AddBroadcastEvent(EventTag, payload);
            });
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack
        {
            [Key(0)] public int Level { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack() { }

            public ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack(int level)
            {
                Level = level;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using MessagePack;
using UniRx;

namespace Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピの製作上限の解放を全プレイヤーへ配信する
    ///     Broadcasts craft-cap unlocks of inheritance recipes to every player
    /// </summary>
    public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket : IBootInitializable
    {
        public const string EventTag = "va:event:levelInheritanceCraftCapUnlock";

        private readonly EventProtocolProvider _eventProtocolProvider;
        private readonly ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup _craftCapLookup;

        public LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket(EventProtocolProvider eventProtocolProvider, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)
        {
            _eventProtocolProvider = eventProtocolProvider;
            _craftCapLookup = craftCapLookup;
        }

        public void Load()
        {
            // 上限の解放を購読し、継承先の基準GUIDとレベルを配信する
            // Subscribe to cap unlocks and broadcast the target base GUID with its level
            _craftCapLookup.OnCraftCapUnlocked.Subscribe(data =>
            {
                var payload = MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack(data.familyBaseItemGuid, data.level));
                _eventProtocolProvider.AddBroadcastEvent(EventTag, payload);
            });
        }

        [MessagePackObject]
        public class LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack
        {
            [Key(0)] public Guid FamilyBaseItemGuid { get; set; }
            [Key(1)] public int Level { get; set; }

            [Obsolete("デシリアライズ用のコンストラクタです。基本的に使用しないでください。")]
            public LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack() { }

            public LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)
            {
                FamilyBaseItemGuid = familyBaseItemGuid;
                Level = level;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/MachineUpgrade/ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using UniRx;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーのモジュールスロット上限のクライアント側ミラー。初期データと購読で更新する
    ///     Client-side mirror of the server's module-slot stack limit, updated from initial data and subscriptions
    /// </summary>
    public class ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore : IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup
    {
        public int CurrentLevel { get; private set; }
        public int CurrentStackLimit => ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.GetStackLimit(CurrentLevel);
        public IObservable<int> OnStackLimitChanged => _onStackLimitChanged;

        private readonly Subject<int> _onStackLimitChanged = new();

        public void Apply(int level)
        {
            if (level == CurrentLevel) return;
            CurrentLevel = level;
            _onStackLimitChanged.OnNext(CurrentStackLimit);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Game/InGame/MachineUpgrade/ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using UniRx;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     サーバーの製作上限のクライアント側ミラー。初期データと購読で更新する
    ///     Client-side mirror of the server's craft caps, updated from initial data and subscriptions
    /// </summary>
    public class ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore : ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup
    {
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<Guid, int> UnlockedCaps => _unlockedCaps;
        public IObservable<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> OnCraftCapUnlocked => _onCraftCapUnlocked;

        private readonly Subject<(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)> _onCraftCapUnlocked = new();
        private readonly Dictionary<Guid, int> _unlockedCaps = new();

        public int GetCraftCap(Guid familyBaseItemGuid)
        {
            return _unlockedCaps.GetValueOrDefault(familyBaseItemGuid, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.InitialCraftCap);
        }

        // サーバーと同じく上がる方向だけを受け入れる
        // Accept only increases, matching the server
        public void Apply(Guid familyBaseItemGuid, int level)
        {
            if (level <= GetCraftCap(familyBaseItemGuid)) return;
            _unlockedCaps[familyBaseItemGuid] = level;
            _onCraftCapUnlocked.OnNext((familyBaseItemGuid, level));
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using Client.Network.API;
using MessagePack;
using Server.Event.EventReceive.MachineUpgrade;
using VContainer.Unity;

namespace Client.Game.InGame.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     スロット上限と製作上限のイベントを購読してミラーへ反映する
    ///     Subscribes to the slot-limit and craft-cap events and applies them to the mirrors
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineUpgradeEventHandler : IInitializable
    {
        private readonly IVanillaApiEvent _vanillaApiEvent;
        private readonly ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore _moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore;
        private readonly ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore _levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore;

        public MachineUpgradeEventHandler(IVanillaApiEvent vanillaApiEvent, ClientModuleSlotStackLimitDatastore moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore, ClientLevelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore)
        {
            _vanillaApiEvent = vanillaApiEvent;
            _moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore = moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore;
            _levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore = levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore;
        }

        public void Initialize()
        {
            _vanillaApiEvent.SubscribeEventResponse(ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket.EventTag, OnModuleSlotStackLevelChanged);
            _vanillaApiEvent.SubscribeEventResponse(LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.EventTag, OnCraftCapUnlocked);
        }

        private void OnModuleSlotStackLevelChanged(byte[] payload)
        {
            var data = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<ModuleSlotStackLevelEventPacket.ModuleSlotStackLevelMessagePack>(payload);
            _moduleSlotStackLimitDatastore.Apply(data.Level);
        }

        private void OnCraftCapUnlocked(byte[] payload)
        {
            var data = MessagePackSerializer.Deserialize<LevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlockEventPacket.LevelInheritanceCraftCapMessagePack>(payload);
            _levelInheritanceCraftCapDatastore.Apply(data.FamilyBaseItemGuid, data.Level);
        }
    }
}
```

### Task C9: Web UI（継承の見せ方・スロット上限・上位レベル素材の宛先）

機械レシピの配信 DTO にレベル継承を足し、レシピ選択行とレシピビューアにバッジを出す。スロット束縛には「受け付けるアイテムID一覧」を足し、上位レベルの素材（継承元の変種と、C11 で基準の要求に充てられる上位の変種）も Shift 移動の宛先を引けるようにする。スロット上限は小さな topic `machine_upgrade.current` で配り、機械のモジュール欄に「1スロット上限 N」を出す。

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.BlockDetail;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.MachineUpgrade;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Mooresmaster.Model.BlocksModule;
using NUnit.Framework;
using Server.Boot;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;

namespace Client.Tests.WebUi.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     継承レシピのDTO（種類・継承元/先の変種・受け付ける最高レベル）と、スロット束縛の受け付けIDを固定する
    ///     Pins the inheritance recipe DTO (kind, source/target variants, max accepted level) and the slot binding's accepted IDs
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineUpgradeDtoTest
    {
        private ServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

        [SetUp]
        public void SetUp()
        {
            (_, _serviceProvider) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
        }

        [Test]
        public void CappedRecipeFollowsCraftCapTest()
        {
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedInheritRecipeGuid);
            var craftCapLookup = _serviceProvider.GetService<ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup>();

            // 未研究の上限つきレシピは Lv1 まで
            // An unresearched capped recipe accepts up to Lv1
            var before = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.Build(recipe, craftCapLookup);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.KindInheritUpToUnlocked, before.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, before.SourceInputIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, before.TargetOutputIndex);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(Ids(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)), before.SourceItemIds);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(Ids(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTarget(1), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTarget(2), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTarget(3)), before.TargetItemIds);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, before.MaxCraftableLevel);

            // 上限を2へ上げると最高レベルも2になる
            // Raising the cap to 2 raises the max level to 2
            _serviceProvider.GetService<ILevelInheritanceCraftCapUnlocker>().UnlockCraftCap(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTargetBaseGuid, 2);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.Build(recipe, craftCapLookup).MaxCraftableLevel);
        }

        [Test]
        public void UncappedAndPlainRecipesTest()
        {
            var craftCapLookup = _serviceProvider.GetService<ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup>();

            // 上限なしはファミリー全長まで受け付ける
            // An uncapped recipe accepts the whole family length
            var inherit = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.Build(MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid), craftCapLookup);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.KindInherit, inherit.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, inherit.MaxCraftableLevel);

            // 継承しないレシピは -1・空・0
            // A non-inheritance recipe is -1, empty and 0
            var plain = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.Build(MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.MachineRecipes.Data[0], craftCapLookup);
            Assert.AreEqual(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.KindNone, plain.Kind);
            Assert.AreEqual(-1, plain.SourceInputIndex);
            Assert.AreEqual(-1, plain.TargetOutputIndex);
            Assert.IsEmpty(plain.SourceItemIds);
            Assert.IsEmpty(plain.TargetItemIds);
            Assert.AreEqual(0, plain.MaxCraftableLevel);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SourceSlotAcceptsEveryVariantTest()
        {
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.InheritRecipeGuid);
            var machineParam = (IMachineParam)MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.MachineId).BlockParam;
            var bindings = MachineSlotBindingDtoBuilder.BuildSlotBindings(recipe, machineParam);

            // 継承元（入力0）は全変種、固定素材（入力1）と出力は自分のIDだけ
            // The source (input 0) accepts every variant; the fixed input (input 1) and the output accept only their own ID
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(Ids(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)), bindings[0].AcceptedItemIds);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new List<int> { bindings[1].ItemId }, bindings[1].AcceptedItemIds);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new List<int> { bindings[2].ItemId }, bindings[2].AcceptedItemIds);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SubstituteInputAcceptsHigherVariantsTest()
        {
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteRecipeGuid);
            var machineParam = (IMachineParam)MasterHolder.BlockMaster.GetBlockMaster(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.MachineId).BlockParam;
            var bindings = MachineSlotBindingDtoBuilder.BuildSlotBindings(recipe, machineParam);

            // 継承しないレシピでも、基準を要求する入力は上位の変種を宛先に含む（C11 のサーバー規則と同じ）
            // Even in a non-inheritance recipe, an input requiring a base lists the higher variants (same as C11's server rule)
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(Ids(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3)), bindings[0].AcceptedItemIds);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new List<int> { bindings[1].ItemId }, bindings[1].AcceptedItemIds);
        }

        private static List<int> Ids(params ItemId[] itemIds)
        {
            var ids = new List<int>();
            foreach (var itemId in itemIds) ids.Add(itemId.AsPrimitive());
            return ids;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.WebUiHost/Game/Topics/MachineUpgrade/MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using Mooresmaster.Model.MachineRecipesModule;

namespace Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     機械レシピのレベル継承をDTOへ組み立てる。継承元・継承先の変種と、今受け付ける最高レベルを返す
    ///     Builds a machine recipe's level inheritance for the DTO: source/target variants and the highest level accepted now
    /// </summary>
    public static class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDtoBuilder
    {
        public const string KindNone = "none";
        public const string KindInherit = "inherit";
        public const string KindInheritUpToUnlocked = "inheritUpToUnlocked";

        public static MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDto Build(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)
        {
            // 継承しないレシピは番号-1・空リスト・0で一様に表す
            // A non-inheritance recipe is uniformly -1 indices, empty lists and 0
            if (!MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.IsInheritance(recipe))
            {
                return new MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDto
                {
                    Kind = KindNone,
                    SourceInputIndex = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.NotInheritanceIndex,
                    SourceItemIds = new List<int>(),
                    TargetOutputIndex = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.NotInheritanceIndex,
                    TargetItemIds = new List<int>(),
                    MaxCraftableLevel = 0,
                };
            }

            // 継承元の変種と、同じレベルの継承先を並べる
            // List the source variants and the target of the same level
            var maxLevel = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetMaxLevel(recipe);
            var sourceItemIds = new List<int>();
            var targetItemIds = new List<int>();
            for (var level = 1; level <= maxLevel; level++)
            {
                sourceItemIds.Add(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceVariant(recipe, level).AsPrimitive());
                targetItemIds.Add(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetTargetVariant(recipe, level).AsPrimitive());
            }

            // 上限つきは研究済みの製作上限、上限なしは継承元ファミリーの長さまで受け付ける
            // Capped recipes accept up to the researched craft cap; uncapped ones up to the source family length
            var hasCraftCap = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.HasCraftCap(recipe);
            var maxCraftableLevel = hasCraftCap ? Math.Min(maxLevel, craftCapLookup.GetCraftCap(MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetCraftCapKey(recipe))) : maxLevel;

            return new MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDto
            {
                Kind = hasCraftCap ? KindInheritUpToUnlocked : KindInherit,
                SourceInputIndex = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetSourceInputIndex(recipe),
                SourceItemIds = sourceItemIds,
                TargetOutputIndex = MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceUtil.GetTargetOutputIndex(recipe),
                TargetItemIds = targetItemIds,
                MaxCraftableLevel = maxCraftableLevel,
            };
        }
    }

    public class MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceDto
    {
        public string Kind;
        public int SourceInputIndex;
        public List<int> SourceItemIds;
        public int TargetOutputIndex;
        public List<int> TargetItemIds;
        public int MaxCraftableLevel;
    }
}
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.WebUiHost/Game/Topics/MachineUpgrade/MachineUpgradeTopic.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using Client.WebUiHost.Boot;
using Client.WebUiHost.Common;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using UniRx;

namespace Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.MachineUpgrade
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     machine_upgrade.current トピック: モジュールスロット1つあたりの上限。クライアントのミラーの変化で再配信
    ///     machine_upgrade.current topic: the per-module-slot stack limit, republished when the client mirror changes
    /// </summary>
    public class MachineUpgradeTopic : ITopicHandler, IDisposable
    {
        public const string TopicName = "machine_upgrade.current";

        private readonly WebSocketHub _hub;
        private readonly IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup _stackLimitLookup;
        private readonly IDisposable _subscription;

        public MachineUpgradeTopic(WebSocketHub hub, IModuleSlotStackLimitLookup stackLimitLookup)
        {
            _hub = hub;
            _stackLimitLookup = stackLimitLookup;

            // ミラーは値を書き換えてから通知するので、ここでは変化後の上限を読める
            // The mirror notifies after updating, so the changed limit is visible here
            _subscription = _stackLimitLookup.OnStackLimitChanged.Subscribe(_ => _hub.Publish(TopicName, BuildJson()));
        }

        public UniTask<string> GetSnapshotJsonAsync()
        {
            return UniTask.FromResult(BuildJson());
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            _subscription.Dispose();
        }

        private string BuildJson()
        {
            return WebUiJson.Serialize(new MachineUpgradeDto { ModuleSlotStackLimit = _stackLimitLookup.CurrentStackLimit });
        }
    }

    public class MachineUpgradeDto
    {
        public int ModuleSlotStackLimit;
    }
}
```

```csharp
        private readonly IDisposable _subscription;
        private readonly ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup _craftCapLookup;
        private readonly IDisposable _craftCapSubscription;

        public MachineRecipesTopic(WebSocketHub hub, IGameUnlockStateData unlockStateData, ILevelInheritanceCraftCapLookup craftCapLookup)
        {
            _hub = hub;
            _unlockStateData = unlockStateData;
            _craftCapLookup = craftCapLookup;

            // ClientGameUnlockStateData より後に購読登録されるため、ここでは更新後の状態を読める
            // Subscribed after ClientGameUnlockStateData, so the updated unlock state is visible here
            _subscription = ClientContext.VanillaApi.Event.SubscribeEventResponse(UnlockedEventPacket.EventTag, _ => _hub.Publish(TopicName, BuildJson()));

            // 製作上限が上がると継承レシピの受け付け最高レベルが変わるため再配信する
            // A raised craft cap changes an inheritance recipe's max accepted level, so republish
            _craftCapSubscription = _craftCapLookup.OnCraftCapUnlocked.Subscribe(_ => _hub.Publish(TopicName, BuildJson()));
        }
```

- [ ] **Step 6: スロット束縛に受け付けIDを足す**

`BlockDetailDtos.cs` の `MachineSlotBindingDto` の `public int Count;` の後に足す:

```csharp
        // このスロットへ入れられるアイテムID。継承元の入力は継承元ファミリーの全変種
        // Item IDs this slot accepts; a source input lists every variant of the source family

```

`MachineSlotBindingDtoBuilder.cs` の `BuildSlotBindings` を次へ置き換える（using に変更なし）:

```csharp
        public static List<MachineSlotBindingDto> BuildSlotBindings(MachineRecipeMasterElement recipe, IMachineParam machineParam)
        {
            var bindings = new List<MachineSlotBindingDto>();
            if (recipe == null) return bindings;

            // 入力はサーバーの束縛と同じ util で受け付けIDを引く（基準の要求なら上位の変種も。継承元も同じ規則）
            // Inputs take their accepted IDs from the same util as the server binding (higher variants for a base requirement; the source follows the same rule)
            for (var i = 0; i < recipe.InputItems.Length; i++)
            {
                var binding = CreateBinding(i, recipe.InputItems[i].ItemGuid, recipe.InputItems[i].Count);
                binding.AcceptedItemIds = ToPrimitiveIds(LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.GetAcceptedInputItemIds(recipe, i));
                bindings.Add(binding);
            }

            for (var j = 0; j < recipe.OutputItems.Length; j++)
            {
                bindings.Add(CreateBinding(machineParam.InputSlotCount + j, recipe.OutputItems[j].ItemGuid, recipe.OutputItems[j].Count));
            }

            return bindings;

            #region Internal

            MachineSlotBindingDto CreateBinding(int slot, System.Guid itemGuid, int count)
            {
                var itemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(itemGuid).AsPrimitive();
                return new MachineSlotBindingDto
                {
                    Slot = slot,
                    ItemId = itemId,
                    Count = count,
                    AcceptedItemIds = new List<int> { itemId },
                };
            }

            List<int> ToPrimitiveIds(IReadOnlyList<ItemId> itemIds)
            {
                var ids = new List<int>(itemIds.Count);
                foreach (var itemId in itemIds) ids.Add(itemId.AsPrimitive());
                return ids;
            }

            #endregion
        }
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";

// 継承しないレシピも同じ形で運ぶ（-1・空配列・0）。Web側で既定値を推測させない
// Non-inheritance recipes ride the same shape (-1, empty arrays, 0) so the web never guesses defaults
export const MachineRecipeLevelInheritanceSchema = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["none", "inherit", "inheritUpToUnlocked"]),
  sourceInputIndex: z.number().int(),
  sourceItemIds: z.array(z.number().int()),
  targetOutputIndex: z.number().int(),
  targetItemIds: z.array(z.number().int()),
  maxCraftableLevel: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
}).strict();

// machine_upgrade.current: モジュールスロット1つあたりの上限
// machine_upgrade.current: the per-module-slot stack limit
export const MachineUpgradeDataSchema = z.object({
  moduleSlotStackLimit: z.number().int().positive(),
}).strict();
```

`moorestech_web/webui/src/features/recipe/logic/levelInheritanceBadge.ts`

```ts
import type { MachineRecipeLevelInheritance } from "@/bridge";
import { L, type InterpolationValues, type TranslationKey } from "@/shared/i18n";

type LevelInheritanceBadgeText = { key: TranslationKey; values: InterpolationValues };

// 継承レシピのバッジ文言（キーと差し込み値）。継承しないレシピは null
// Badge copy (key and values) for an inheritance recipe; null for a non-inheritance recipe
export function levelInheritanceBadgeText(inheritance: MachineRecipeLevelInheritance): LevelInheritanceBadgeText | null {
  switch (inheritance.kind) {
    case "none":
      return null;
    case "inherit":
      return { key: L.ui.recipe.levelInheritance, values: {} };
    case "inheritUpToUnlocked":
      return { key: L.ui.recipe.levelInheritanceCapped, values: { level: inheritance.maxCraftableLevel } };
  }
}
```

`machineSlotGhosts.ts` の `boundMachineInputSlotsForItem` の return 行を次へ置き換え、直前のコメントへ1組足す:

```ts
// 継承元スロットと基準を要求する入力は上位レベルの変種も受け付けるため、ホスト配信の acceptedItemIds で照合する
// Source slots and base-requiring inputs also accept higher-level variants, so match against the host-published acceptedItemIds
  return machine.slotBindings.filter((binding) => inputBand.has(binding.slot) && binding.acceptedItemIds.includes(itemId)).map((binding) => binding.slot);
```

`craftLogic.ts`: `buildRecipeEntries` の `.filter((r) => r.outputItems.some((o) => o.itemId === itemId))` を `.filter((r) => producesItem(r, itemId))` に置き換え、ファイル末尾に足す:

```ts

// 継承レシピは基準の生産物に加え、継承先の全レベルを生産物として扱う
// An inheritance recipe produces every level of its target in addition to the base output
function producesItem(recipe: MachineRecipe, itemId: number): boolean {
  return recipe.outputItems.some((o) => o.itemId === itemId) || recipe.levelInheritance.targetItemIds.includes(itemId);
}
```

### Task C12: 研究ノードに機械強化の解放2種を出し、研究の充足に上位レベルを数える（Web UI）

研究ノードの詳細ペインの「解放: その他」に、`unlockModuleSlotStackLevel` を「モジュールスロット上限 N」、`unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel` を「〇〇を LvN まで製作可能」として出す。前例は同じ節のテキスト行 `connectTool`・`trainCar`（`UnlockSections` の SECTIONS 表＋ホスト DTO の専用フィールド＋表示台帳）。C6・C7 が一時的に非表示台帳へ入れた2種を表示台帳へ移す。あわせて、研究の消費アイテムに C11 の受け付けID（基準なら上位の変種も）を載せ、詳細ペインの不足表示が上位レベルの所持も数えるようにする（サーバーの充足判定と同じ規則）。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.WebUiHost/Game/Topics/Research/ResearchTopicDtos.cs`
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.WebUiHost/Game/Topics/Research/ResearchNodeDtoFactory.cs`（145 行 → 約 175 行）
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/WebUi/Research/ResearchUnlockGameActionCoverageTest.cs`

- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/WebUi/WireContractResearchTest.cs`・`WireFixtures/research_tree.json`
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/WebUi/Localization/HostContentIdentityWireTest.cs:52-58`
- Modify: `Localization/localization.csv`（2行追加）→ 生成物 `moorestech_web/webui/src/shared/i18n/generated/localizationKeys.ts`
- Modify: `moorestech_web/webui/src/bridge/contract/schemas/research.ts`
- Modify: `moorestech_web/webui/src/features/research/unlock/unlockEntries.ts`・`unlock/UnlockSections.tsx`
- Create: `moorestech_web/webui/src/features/research/unlock/UnlockCraftCapLabel.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C6 の `unlockModuleSlotStackLevel`（生成型 `UnlockModuleSlotStackLevelGameActionParam.Level`）と `ModuleSlotStackLimitMasterUtil.GetStackLimit(int level)`、C7 の `unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel`（`UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevelGameActionParam.TargetItemGuids`・`.Level`）、C11 の `LevelFamilySubstituteUtil.GetAcceptedItemIds`、テスト用研究 `ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid`・`CraftCapResearchGuid`・`SubstituteResearchGuid`
- Produces（webui の契約。topic `research.tree`）:
  - `ResearchNodeData.consumeItems[].acceptedItemIds: number[]`（必須。要求が基準なら全変種を下位から、それ以外は `[itemId]`）
  - `ResearchNodeData.unlockModuleSlotStackLimits: number[]`（必須。レベルではなく解放後の上限値。正の整数）
  - `ResearchNodeData.unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps: { itemId: number; level: number }[]`（必須。`itemId` は継承先ファミリーの基準アイテム、`level` は解放後の製作上限。正の整数）
  - ホスト DTO: `ResearchConsumeItemDto.AcceptedItemIds`（`List<int>`）・`ResearchNodeDto.UnlockModuleSlotStackLimits`（`List<int>`）・`ResearchNodeDto.UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps`（`List<ResearchUnlockCraftCapDto>`）・`ResearchUnlockCraftCapDto { int ItemId; int Level; }`
  - `UnlockEntry` の kind `"moduleSlotStackLimit"`・`"levelInheritanceCraftCap"`（どちらも「解放: その他」節）
  - testid: `research-unlock-module-slot-stack-limit`・`research-unlock-craft-cap-{itemId}`
  - i18n キー: `ui.research.unlockModuleSlotStackLimit`（差し込み `{limit}`）・`ui.research.unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCap`（差し込み `{itemName}`・`{level}`）
  - `ownedCountOfAny(owned: Map<number, number>, itemIds: readonly number[]): number`（`@/shared/ownedCounts`）
  - `isConsumeItemLacking(node, acceptedItemIds: readonly number[], required, owned)`（第2引数を itemId から受け付けID配列へ変更）

```csharp

        [Test]
        public void Createはスロット上限と製作上限と代替の受け付けIDを出す()
        {
            var (_, _) = new MoorestechServerDIContainerGenerator().Create(new MoorestechServerDIContainerOptions(TestModDirectory.ForUnitTestModDirectory));
            var states = new Dictionary<Guid, ResearchNodeState>();

            // スロット上限はレベルでなく上限値で運ぶ（テストマスタの段階表 [3, 6] の level 1 は 6）
            // The slot limit travels as the limit value, not the level (level 1 of the test table [3, 6] is 6)
            var slot = ResearchNodeDtoFactory.Create(MasterHolder.ResearchMaster.ResearchElements[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.ModuleSlotStackResearchGuid], states);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 6 }, slot.UnlockModuleSlotStackLimits);
            CollectionAssert.IsEmpty(slot.UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps);

            // 製作上限は継承先ファミリーの基準アイテムIDと解放後のレベル
            // The craft cap carries the target family's base item ID and the unlocked level
            var cap = ResearchNodeDtoFactory.Create(MasterHolder.ResearchMaster.ResearchElements[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CraftCapResearchGuid], states);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, cap.UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.CappedTarget(1).AsPrimitive(), cap.UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps[0].ItemId);
            Assert.AreEqual(2, cap.UnlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps[0].Level);

            // 基準を消費する研究は上位の変種も受け付けIDに並ぶ（下位から）。基準でない消費は自分だけ
            // A research consuming a base lists the higher variants too (lowest first); a non-base consume lists only itself
            var substitute = ResearchNodeDtoFactory.Create(MasterHolder.ResearchMaster.ResearchElements[ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.SubstituteResearchGuid], states);
            var sourceIds = new[] { ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(1).AsPrimitive(), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(2).AsPrimitive(), ForUnitTestLevelInheritanceIds.Source(3).AsPrimitive() };
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(sourceIds, substitute.ConsumeItems[0].AcceptedItemIds);
            var plain = ResearchNodeDtoFactory.Create(MasterHolder.ResearchMaster.ResearchElements[Guid.Parse("cd05e30d-d599-46d3-a079-769113cbbf17")], states);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { plain.ConsumeItems[0].ItemId }, plain.ConsumeItems[0].AcceptedItemIds);
        }
```

```bash
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
root = 'moorestech_web/webui/'
# (path, consumeItems 要素の置換数, ノード定義への追加数)
targets = [
    ('src/bridge/contract/validators.test.ts', 1, 1),
    ('src/bridge/contract/schemas/__tests__/guidValidation.test.ts', 0, 1),
    ('src/bridge/contract/schemas/__tests__/contentIdentity.test.ts', 0, 1),
    ('src/features/research/researchLogic.test.ts', 9, 1),
    ('src/features/research/ResearchTreePanel.test.ts', 1, 1),
    ('src/features/research/ResearchDetailPane.test.ts', 1, 1),
    ('src/features/research/ResearchNodeCard.test.ts', 0, 1),
    ('e2e/mock-host/researchFixtures.ts', 3, 4),
]
consume = re.compile(r'\{ itemId: (\d+), count: (\d+) \}')
train = re.compile(r'unlockTrainCarGuids: \[[^\]\n]*\],')
for path, consume_expected, train_expected in targets:
    text = open(root + path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    lines = text.split('\n')
    consume_count = 0
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if 'consumeItems: [' in line:
            lines[i], n = consume.subn(r'{ itemId: \1, count: \2, acceptedItemIds: [\1] }', line)
            consume_count += n
    text = '\n'.join(lines)

    # 行頭のフィールドなら同じ字下げで2行足し、1行に並ぶ定義なら同じ行へ続ける
    # A field at the start of a line gets two lines at the same indent; an inline definition continues on the same line
    def add_fields(m):
        line_start = text.rfind('\n', 0, m.start()) + 1
        indent = text[line_start:m.start()]
        if indent.strip() == '':
            return f'{m.group(0)}\n{indent}unlockModuleSlotStackLimits: [],\n{indent}unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps: [],'
        return f'{m.group(0)} unlockModuleSlotStackLimits: [], unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps: [],'
    text, train_count = train.subn(add_fields, text, count=train_expected)
    assert (consume_count, train_count) == (consume_expected, train_expected), (path, consume_count, train_count)

    text = re.sub(r'isConsumeItemLacking\(n, (\d+),', r'isConsumeItemLacking(n, [\1],', text)
    open(root + path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)

# e2e の研究可能ノードに機械強化の解放2種を持たせる / give the researchable e2e node both machine-upgrade unlocks
path = root + 'e2e/mock-host/researchFixtures.ts'
text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
old = 'unlockTrainCarGuids: ["66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"],\n      unlockModuleSlotStackLimits: [],\n      unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps: [],'
new = 'unlockTrainCarGuids: ["66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"],\n      unlockModuleSlotStackLimits: [6],\n      unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps: [{ itemId: 2, level: 2 }],'
assert text.count(old) == 1
open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text.replace(old, new))
```

```ts

// 代替を受け付ける要求の所持数。受け付けるIDそれぞれの所持数を合計する
// Owned count for a requirement that accepts substitutes; sums the owned count of every accepted ID
export function ownedCountOfAny(owned: Map<number, number>, itemIds: readonly number[]): number {
  return itemIds.reduce((total, itemId) => total + ownedCountOf(owned, itemId), 0);
}
```

- `isConsumeItemLacking`（16-21 行）を置き換える:

```ts
// 消費アイテム1件の不足強調。上位レベルの代替品も所持に数える。完了/未受信中は出さない（表示専用でボタン活性には効かない）
// Per-item shortage highlight counting higher-level substitutes; hidden while completed or unreceived (display only, never gates the button)
export function isConsumeItemLacking(node: ResearchNodeData, acceptedItemIds: readonly number[], required: number, owned: Map<number, number> | null): boolean {
  if (owned === null) return false;
  return node.state !== "completed" && ownedCountOfAny(owned, acceptedItemIds) < required;
}
```

### Task C10: 画面まで通す（EditModeInPlayingTest とプレイ録画）

実ゲームの起動経路で「研究 → サーバーの DataStore → イベント → クライアントのミラー → Web UI の配信」が通ることを EditModeInPlayingTest で確かめ、本番マスタの機械を開いたときにモジュール欄へ上限が描かれ、研究相当の解放で書き換わることをプレイ録画で確かめる。継承バッジの見た目は本番マスタに継承レシピが入る S2/Part D の録画で確かめる（Part C の本番マスタには継承レシピが無い）。研究ノードに出す解放2種（C12）は、実ゲームの `research.tree` の配信に中身が載ることをこの EditModeInPlayingTest で確かめ、詳細ペインの DOM は C12 の Playwright e2e で確かめる。本番マスタの研究ノードを開いた録画は、そのノードを足す Part D に渡す（Part C の時点の本番マスタには該当ノードが無い）。

**Files:**
- Modify: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/ServerData/mods/EditModeInPlayingTestMod/master/items.json`・`machineRecipes.json`・`research.json`
- Create: `moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/BlockInventory/MachineUpgradeWebUiTopicTest.cs`
- 録画シナリオ: `moorestech_client/PlaytestResults/scratch/module-slot-stack-limit-label.cs`（git 管理外。スキルの scenarios へは足さない）

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: C6〜C9・C12 のすべて（`unlockModuleSlotStackLevel`・`unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel`・topic `machine_upgrade.current`・`MachineRecipe.levelInheritance`・`slotBindings[].acceptedItemIds`・testid `machine-module-stack-limit`・`research.tree` の `unlockModuleSlotStackLimits`・`unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps`）
- Produces: EditModeInPlayingTestMod の継承の最小例（S2/Part D の UI 録画の手本）
  - アイテム `継承テスト素材Lv1..3`（`00000000-0000-0000-e0de-00000000001{1,2,3}`）・`継承テスト製品Lv1..3`（`…-00000000002{1,2,3}`）、levelFamilies 2件
  - 機械レシピ `00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000e0de0001`（キャンプファイア、素材Lv1×1 → 製品Lv1×1、`InheritUpToUnlocked`）
  - 研究 `e0de0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001`（`unlockModuleSlotStackLevel {level:1}` と `unlockLevelInheritanceCraftLevel {targetItemGuids:[製品Lv1], level:2}`）

```bash
import copy, json, re
root = 'moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/ServerData/mods/EditModeInPlayingTestMod/master/'

def load(name):
    text = open(root + name, encoding='utf-8').read()
    return text, json.loads(text), len(re.match(r'\{\n( +)', text).group(1))

def save(name, text, data, indent):
    open(root + name, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=indent) + ('\n' if text.endswith('\n') else ''))

# 継承元・継承先のファミリー（粘土を雛形に3レベルずつ） / source and target families cloned from 粘土

families = []
for name, head in (('継承テスト素材', 1), ('継承テスト製品', 2)):
    guids = []
    for level in range(1, 4):
        item = copy.deepcopy(template)
        item['name'] = f'{name}Lv{level}'
        item['itemGuid'] = f'00000000-0000-0000-e0de-0000000000{head}{level}'
        items['data'].append(item)
        guids.append(item['itemGuid'])
    families.append({'familyGuid': f'00000000-0000-0000-e0de-0000000000f{head}', 'name': f'{name}Family', 'baseItemGuid': guids[0], 'levelItemGuids': guids})
items['levelFamilies'] = families
save('items.json', text, items, indent)

# キャンプファイアの上限つき継承レシピ / capped inheritance recipe on the campfire
```

`moorestech_client/Assets/Scripts/Client.Tests/EditModeInPlayingTest/BlockInventory/MachineUpgradeWebUiTopicTest.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using Client.Game.InGame.Context;
using Client.Tests.EditModeInPlayingTest.Util;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics;
using Client.WebUiHost.Game.Topics.MachineUpgrade;
using Core.Master;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Research;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using UnityEditor;
#endif
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using static Client.Tests.EditModeInPlayingTest.Util.EditModeInPlayingTestUtil;

namespace Client.Tests.EditModeInPlayingTest.BlockInventory
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     研究の解放がイベント→クライアントのミラー→Web UIの配信まで届くことを、実ゲームの起動経路で確かめる
    ///     Verifies, through the real game boot, that research unlocks reach the Web UI topics via events and client mirrors
    /// </summary>
    // shard割当はクラスと一緒に移動・改名される
    // The shard assignment travels with the class through moves and renames
    [Category("CiShardClientPlay2")]
    public class MachineUpgradeWebUiTopicTest
    {
        private const string MachineBlockName = "キャンプファイア";
        private static readonly Guid InheritRecipeGuid = Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000e0de0001");
        private static readonly Guid MachineUpgradeResearchGuid = Guid.Parse("e0de0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001");

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator 研究でスロット上限と製作上限がWebUIの配信へ届く()
        {
            EnterPlayModeUtil();

            // yield return new EnterPlayMode　は必ず[UnityTest]関数の直下で呼び出すこと。そうでないとなぜかわからないがプレイモードに入らない
            // Always call yield return new EnterPlayMode directly under the [UnityTest] function. Otherwise, for unknown reasons, it will not enter PlayMode.
            yield return new EnterPlayMode(expectDomainReload: true);

            // EnterPlayMode時のテストフレームワーク内部エラーでテストが失敗するのを防ぐ
            // Prevent test failure from test framework internal errors during EnterPlayMode.
            LogAssert.ignoreFailingMessages = true;

            yield return Body().ToCoroutine();

            yield return new ExitPlayMode();

            // テスト終了後にデバッグオブジェクト無効化フラグをクリア
            // Clear debug objects disabled flag after test.
#if UNITY_EDITOR
            SessionState.SetBool("DebugObjectsBootstrap_Disabled", false);
#endif

            #region Internal

            async UniTask Body()
            {
                await LoadMainGame();

                // 機械を置いて開き、Web UIと同じ登録済みハンドラで継承レシピを選ぶ
                // Place and open the machine, then select the inheritance recipe through the Web UI's registered handler
                var pos = new Vector3Int(0, 0, 0);
                PlaceBlock(MachineBlockName, pos, BlockDirection.North);
                var blockGameObject = await WaitBlockGameObjectSpawn(pos);
                var subInventoryState = await BlockSubInventoryOpener.Open(blockGameObject);
                var select = await WebUiActionInvoker.ExecuteAsync("machine_recipe.select", new JObject { ["operation"] = "set", ["recipeGuid"] = InheritRecipeGuid.ToString() });
                Assert.IsTrue(select.Ok, $"select action failed: {select.Error}");

                // 研究前: スロット上限3・製作上限Lv1・継承元スロットは3変種を受け付ける
                // Before research: slot limit 3, craft cap Lv1, and the source slot accepts all three variants
                Assert.AreEqual(3, await ModuleSlotStackLimit());
                var levelInheritance = (await InheritRecipe())["levelInheritance"];
                Assert.AreEqual("inheritUpToUnlocked", levelInheritance["kind"].Value<string>());
                Assert.AreEqual(1, levelInheritance["maxCraftableLevel"].Value<int>());
                Assert.AreEqual(3, await SourceSlotAcceptedCount());

                // サーバーで研究を完了させ、2つのtopicが再配信されるまで待つ
                // Complete the research server-side and wait until both topics are republished
                var playerId = ClientContext.PlayerConnectionSetting.PlayerId;
                Assert.IsTrue(ServerContext.GetService<IResearchDataStore>().CompleteResearch(MachineUpgradeResearchGuid, playerId), "research did not complete");

                var stackLimit = await ModuleSlotStackLimit();
                for (var i = 0; i < 50 && stackLimit != 6; i++)
                {
                    await UniTask.Delay(100);
                    stackLimit = await ModuleSlotStackLimit();
                }
                Assert.AreEqual(6, stackLimit, "slot limit did not reach the Web UI topic");

                var maxCraftableLevel = (await InheritRecipe())["levelInheritance"]["maxCraftableLevel"].Value<int>();
                for (var i = 0; i < 50 && maxCraftableLevel != 2; i++)
                {
                    await UniTask.Delay(100);
                    maxCraftableLevel = (await InheritRecipe())["levelInheritance"]["maxCraftableLevel"].Value<int>();
                }
                Assert.AreEqual(2, maxCraftableLevel, "craft cap did not reach the Web UI topic");

                // 研究ノードの配信に解放2種の中身が載る（研究画面「解放: その他」の元データ。スロット上限はレベル1の上限値6）
                // The research node payload carries both unlocks (the source of the research screen's "Unlocks: Others"; the slot limit is level 1's value 6)
                var upgradeNode = await ResearchNode();
                CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { 6 }, upgradeNode["unlockModuleSlotStackLimits"].ToObject<int[]>());
                var craftCap = (JObject)((JArray)upgradeNode["unlockLevelInheritanceCraftCaps"])[0];
                var productLv1ItemId = MasterHolder.ItemMaster.GetItemId(Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-e0de-000000000021")).AsPrimitive();
                Assert.AreEqual(productLv1ItemId, craftCap["itemId"].Value<int>());
                Assert.AreEqual(2, craftCap["level"].Value<int>());

                BlockSubInventoryOpener.Close(subInventoryState);
            }

            // 登録済みtopicのsnapshotをJSONで読む
            // Read a registered topic's snapshot as JSON
            async UniTask<JObject> Snapshot(string topicName)
            {
                var hub = Client.WebUiHost.Boot.WebUiHost.Hub;
                Assert.IsNotNull(hub, "WebUiHost hub is not running");
                var handler = hub.ResolveTopic(topicName);
                Assert.IsNotNull(handler, $"topic '{topicName}' is not registered by WebUiGameBinder");
                return JObject.Parse(await handler.GetSnapshotJsonAsync());
            }

            async UniTask<int> ModuleSlotStackLimit()
            {
                return (await Snapshot(MachineUpgradeTopic.TopicName))["moduleSlotStackLimit"].Value<int>();
            }

            async UniTask<JObject> ResearchNode()
            {
                foreach (var node in (JArray)(await Snapshot(ResearchTopic.TopicName))["nodes"])
                {
                    if (node["guid"].Value<string>() == MachineUpgradeResearchGuid.ToString()) return (JObject)node;
                }
                Assert.Fail("machine upgrade research is not in research.tree");
                return null;
            }

            async UniTask<JObject> InheritRecipe()
            {
                foreach (var recipe in (JArray)(await Snapshot(MachineRecipesTopic.TopicName))["recipes"])
                {
                    if (recipe["recipeGuid"].Value<string>() == InheritRecipeGuid.ToString("D")) return (JObject)recipe;
                }
                Assert.Fail("inheritance recipe is not in crafting.machine_recipes");
                return null;
            }

            // 選択レシピの束縛がブロック状態の同期で届くまで待ち、継承元スロットの受け付けID数を返す
            // Wait for the selected recipe's binding to arrive with the block-state sync and return the source slot's accepted ID count
            async UniTask<int> SourceSlotAcceptedCount()
            {
                var bindings = (await Snapshot(BlockInventoryTopic.TopicName))["machine"]["slotBindings"] as JArray;
                for (var i = 0; i < 50 && bindings.Count == 0; i++)
                {
                    await UniTask.Delay(100);
                    bindings = (await Snapshot(BlockInventoryTopic.TopicName))["machine"]["slotBindings"] as JArray;
                }
                Assert.IsNotEmpty(bindings, "slot bindings never arrived after selecting the recipe");
                return ((JArray)bindings[0]["acceptedItemIds"]).Count;
            }

            #endregion
        }
    }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: プレイ録画でモジュール欄の上限表示を撮る**

本番マスタ（ピン先の moorestech_master worktree）の `石窯`（moduleSlotCount 4）を開き、モジュール欄の上限が 3 → 6 に書き換わることを DOM と録画で確かめる。研究ノードは Part D が足すので、ここではサーバーの Unlocker を直接呼んで解放する（検証対象は解放後の同期と描画）。

`moorestech_client/PlaytestResults/scratch/module-slot-stack-limit-label.cs`

```csharp
// モジュール欄の「1スロット上限 N」が描かれ、上限の解放で書き換わることを撮る
// Capture the module area's "per-slot limit N" label and its rewrite when the limit is raised
using Client.Game.InGame.UI.UIState;
using Client.Playtest;
using Client.Playtest.WebUi;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.MachineUpgrade;
using UnityEngine;

var ovenBlockName = "石窯";
var flatGroundObjectName = "PlaytestFlatGround";
var testFieldTopY = 200f;
var ovenModelCenterOffset = new Vector3(1.5f, 1f, 1.5f);
var options = new PlaytestRunOptions { Record = true };
return PlaytestRunner.Run("module-slot-stack-limit-label", options, async p =>
{
    await p.SkipOpeningSkitIfPlaying();
    await p.Until(() => p.CurrentUiState == UIStateEnum.GameScreen, 15f, "GameScreenに到達");

    // 自然地形の干渉を避けるため、足場を上空へ移して石窯を置く（interact-key-unification と同じ手順）
    // Move the scaffold to empty sky to avoid terrain interference and place the oven (same as interact-key-unification)
    await p.SetupFlatGround();
    GameObject.Find(flatGroundObjectName).transform.position = new Vector3(0f, testFieldTopY - 2f, 0f);
    p.WarpPlayer(new Vector3(0f, testFieldTopY + 1f, 0f));
    await p.WaitSeconds(1.5f);
    var ovenOrigin = new Vector3Int(-1, Mathf.RoundToInt(testFieldTopY), 1);
    p.PlaceBlockDirect(ovenBlockName, ovenOrigin, BlockDirection.North);
    var ovenGameObject = await p.WaitBlockGameObject(ovenOrigin);
    await p.WaitSeconds(1f);

    p.Note("石窯をF単押しで開く");
    await p.AimAt(ovenGameObject.transform.position + ovenModelCenterOffset);
    await p.PressInteract();
    await p.WaitUiState(UIStateEnum.SubInventory, 5f);

    // 初期値（レベル0＝3）が描かれている
    // The initial value (level 0 = 3) is drawn
    var before = await PlaytestDomQuery.Query("machine-module-stack-limit", 10f);
    p.Note($"[Web UI DOM] found={before.Found} text={before.Text}");
    p.Assert(before.Found && before.Text == "1スロット上限 3", "モジュール欄に「1スロット上限 3」が描かれる");
    await p.Screenshot("01-module-stack-limit-3");

    // 上限をレベル1へ上げ、イベント→ミラー→topic→DOM の書き換えを待つ
    // Raise the limit to level 1 and wait for the event → mirror → topic → DOM rewrite
    p.Note("サーバーでスロット上限をレベル1（6）へ上げる");
    p.ServerService<IModuleSlotStackLimitUnlocker>().UnlockLevel(1);
    var after = await PlaytestDomQuery.Query("machine-module-stack-limit", 2f);
    for (var i = 0; i < 20 && after.Text != "1スロット上限 6"; i++)
    {
        await p.WaitSeconds(0.5f);
        after = await PlaytestDomQuery.Query("machine-module-stack-limit", 2f);
    }
    p.Note($"[Web UI DOM] found={after.Found} text={after.Text}");
    p.Assert(after.Found && after.Text == "1スロット上限 6", "解放後に「1スロット上限 6」へ書き換わる");
    await p.Screenshot("02-module-stack-limit-6");
});
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/CleanRoomYield/ChipYieldFormulaTest.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class ChipYieldFormulaTest
    {
        // Part B の初期値。行はクラスA→Dの順（品質倍率・層失敗率・ダイ損失率）
        // Initial values from Part B, rows ordered class A to D (quality multiplier, layer fail rate, die loss rate)
        private static readonly (float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate)[] ClassRows =
        {
            (1.0f, 0.10f, 0.15f),
            (0.75f, 0.15f, 0.22f),
            (0.5f, 0.20f, 0.30f),
            (0.25f, 0.25f, 0.38f),
        };

        private static readonly float[][] GradeDieTables =
        {
            new[] { 1f },
            new[] { 0.7f, 0.3f },
            new[] { 0.55f, 0.3f, 0.15f },
            new[] { 0.45f, 0.3f, 0.17f, 0.08f },
            new[] { 0.4f, 0.28f, 0.18f, 0.09f, 0.05f },
        };

        private const double MaxPromotionChance = 0.9;
        private const double MaxReduction = 0.8;
        private const int LayerCount = 3;
        private const int DiesPerWafer = 300;
        private const int GradeCount = 5;
        private const int DieLevelCount = 5;

        [TestCase(0, 5, 1)]
        [TestCase(1, 5, 2)]
        [TestCase(4, 5, 5)]
        [TestCase(7, 5, 5)]
        [TestCase(2, 3, 3)]
        public void MaxWaferGradeIsHighestTierPlusOneTest(int highestTier, int gradeCount, int expected)
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(expected, ChipYieldFormula.MaxWaferGrade(highestTier, gradeCount));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PromotionChanceIsClampedProductTest()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(0.9, ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(1.0, 1.0, 0.9), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.2, ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(0.4, 0.5, 0.9), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.0, ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(0.0, 1.0, 0.9), 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ReducedRateClampsQualityReductionTest()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(0.07, ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(0.10, 0.3, 0.8), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.02, ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(0.10, 2.0, 0.8), 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.10, ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(0.10, 0.0, 0.8), 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void WaferGradeProbabilitiesMatchClosedFormTest()
        {
            // 上限未満は u^(g-1)(1-u)、上限は残り全部 u^(max-1)
            // Below the cap each grade is u^(g-1)(1-u); the cap takes the remainder u^(max-1)
            var probabilities = ChipYieldFormula.WaferGradeProbabilities(0.6, 3);
            Assert.AreEqual(3, probabilities.Length);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4, probabilities[0], 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.24, probabilities[1], 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.36, probabilities[2], 1e-9);

            var single = ChipYieldFormula.WaferGradeProbabilities(0.6, 1);
            Assert.AreEqual(1, single.Length);
            Assert.AreEqual(1.0, single[0], 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void WorkedExampleExpectedDiesTest()
        {
            // クラスA・品質合計0.6・最高tier2: u=0.6、層失敗0.04、ダイ損失0.06、生存=0.96^3×300×0.94=249.4956
            // Class A, quality sum 0.6, top tier 2: u=0.6, layer fail 0.04, die loss 0.06, survivors 0.96^3x300x0.94=249.4956
            var expected = ExpectedDies(ClassRows[0], 0.6, 2);
            Assert.AreEqual(191.1136, expected[0], 1e-3);
            Assert.AreEqual(44.9092, expected[1], 1e-3);
            Assert.AreEqual(13.4728, expected[2], 1e-3);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.0, expected[3], 1e-9);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.0, expected[4], 1e-9);
        }

        [Test]
        public void QualityGateNeverYieldsAboveTierPlusOneTest()
        {
            // 最高tier t の構成では Lv t+2 以上の期待値が0、Lv t+1 は正
            // With top tier t, every level from t+2 upward has zero expectation and level t+1 is positive
            for (var highestTier = 0; highestTier <= 3; highestTier++)
            {
                foreach (var classRow in ClassRows)
                {
                    var expected = ExpectedDies(classRow, 1.5, highestTier);
                    Assert.Greater(expected[highestTier], 0.0, $"tier {highestTier}");
                    for (var levelIndex = highestTier + 1; levelIndex < DieLevelCount; levelIndex++)
                    {
                        Assert.AreEqual(0.0, expected[levelIndex], 1e-12, $"tier {highestTier} level {levelIndex + 1}");
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void ClassImprovementNeverReducesGoodTotalOrUpperLevelsTest()
        {
            // クラスを上げても良品合計とLv2以上は減らない。Lv1は減ってよい
            // A better class never lowers the good total or the Lv2+ count; Lv1 may drop
            var moduleConfigs = new (double qualitySum, int highestTier)[] { (0.0, 0), (0.3, 1), (0.6, 2), (0.9, 4), (1.5, 4) };
            foreach (var (qualitySum, highestTier) in moduleConfigs)
            {
                for (var better = 0; better < ClassRows.Length - 1; better++)
                {
                    var betterDies = ExpectedDies(ClassRows[better], qualitySum, highestTier);
                    var worseDies = ExpectedDies(ClassRows[better + 1], qualitySum, highestTier);
                    Assert.GreaterOrEqual(Sum(betterDies, 0) + 1e-9, Sum(worseDies, 0), $"total sum {qualitySum} rows {better}/{better + 1}");
                    Assert.GreaterOrEqual(Sum(betterDies, 1) + 1e-9, Sum(worseDies, 1), $"Lv2+ sum {qualitySum} rows {better}/{better + 1}");
                }
            }
        }

        #region TestHelper

        private static double[] ExpectedDies((float qualityMultiplier, float layerFailRate, float dieLossRate) classRow, double qualitySum, int highestTier)
        {
            var maxGrade = ChipYieldFormula.MaxWaferGrade(highestTier, GradeCount);
            var chance = ChipYieldFormula.PromotionChance(qualitySum, classRow.qualityMultiplier, MaxPromotionChance);
            var gradeProbabilities = ChipYieldFormula.WaferGradeProbabilities(chance, maxGrade);
            var layerFail = ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(classRow.layerFailRate, qualitySum, MaxReduction);
            var dieLoss = ChipYieldFormula.ReducedRate(classRow.dieLossRate, qualitySum, MaxReduction);
            return ChipYieldFormula.ExpectedGoodDiesByLevel(gradeProbabilities, layerFail, LayerCount, DiesPerWafer, dieLoss, GradeDieTables, DieLevelCount);
        }

        private static double Sum(IReadOnlyList<double> values, int fromIndex)
        {
            var total = 0.0;
            for (var i = fromIndex; i < values.Count; i++) total += values[i];
            return total;
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Tests/UnitTest/Game/CleanRoomYield/ChipYieldDrawTest.cs`

```csharp
using Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.CleanRoomYield
{
    public class ChipYieldDrawTest
    {
        private static readonly float[] GradeThreeTable = { 0.55f, 0.3f, 0.15f };

        [Test]
        public void SameSeedReproducesEveryDrawTest()
        {
            // 同じシードからはグレード・層判定・ダイ振り分けまで同じ結果になる
            // The same seed reproduces the grade, the layer roll and the die split
            var first = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(123456789L);
            var second = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(123456789L);
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.6, 5, first), ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.6, 5, second));
            Assert.AreEqual(ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.3, first), ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.3, second));
            var firstDicing = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.2, GradeThreeTable, first);
            var secondDicing = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.2, GradeThreeTable, second);
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(firstDicing.GoodDieCountsByLevel, secondDicing.GoodDieCountsByLevel);
            Assert.AreEqual(firstDicing.FailedDieCount, secondDicing.FailedDieCount);
        }

        [Test]
        public void WaferGradeStaysWithinCapTest()
        {
            // 昇格確率1でも上限で止まり、0なら常にG1
            // Even a certain promotion stops at the cap, and zero chance always yields G1
            for (var seed = 0L; seed < 200; seed++)
            {
                Assert.AreEqual(3, ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(1.0, 3, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed)));
                Assert.AreEqual(1, ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.0, 5, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed)));
                Assert.AreEqual(1, ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.9, 1, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed)));
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void WaferGradeFrequencyMatchesClosedFormTest()
        {
            // 20000回の頻度が閉形式 [0.4, 0.24, 0.36] に収まる（標準誤差は約0.0035）
            // 20000 draws land on the closed form [0.4, 0.24, 0.36] (standard error ~0.0035)
            const int drawCount = 20000;
            var counts = new int[3];
            var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(42L);
            for (var i = 0; i < drawCount; i++) counts[ChipYieldDraw.DrawWaferGrade(0.6, 3, random) - 1]++;
            Assert.AreEqual(0.4, counts[0] / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.24, counts[1] / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
            Assert.AreEqual(0.36, counts[2] / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
        }

        [Test]
        public void LayerFailureFrequencyMatchesRateTest()
        {
            const int drawCount = 20000;
            var failures = 0;
            var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(7L);
            for (var i = 0; i < drawCount; i++)
            {
                if (ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.25, random)) failures++;
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(0.25, failures / (double)drawCount, 0.02);
            Assert.IsFalse(ChipYieldDraw.DrawLayerFailure(0.0, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(1L)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DicingConservesDieCountTest()
        {
            // 良品の各レベルと失敗の合計は常に1枚あたりのダイ数に一致する
            // Good dies across levels plus failed dies always equal the dies per wafer
            for (var seed = 0L; seed < 100; seed++)
            {
                var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.3, GradeThreeTable, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(seed));
                Assert.AreEqual(3, result.GoodDieCountsByLevel.Count);
                var total = result.FailedDieCount;
                foreach (var count in result.GoodDieCountsByLevel) total += count;
                Assert.AreEqual(300, total);
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void DicingMeanMatchesExpectationTest()
        {
            // 損失0.1・表[.55,.3,.15]: 良品の平均270、Lv3の平均40.5（2000枚の標準誤差は約0.12と0.13）
            // Loss 0.1 with table [.55,.3,.15]: good mean 270, Lv3 mean 40.5 (standard errors ~0.12 and ~0.13 over 2000 wafers)
            const int waferCount = 2000;
            var goodTotal = 0L;
            var levelThreeTotal = 0L;
            var random = new CleanRoomDrawRandom(2026L);
            for (var i = 0; i < waferCount; i++)
            {
                var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.1, GradeThreeTable, random);
                foreach (var count in result.GoodDieCountsByLevel) goodTotal += count;
                levelThreeTotal += result.GoodDieCountsByLevel[2];
            }
            Assert.AreEqual(270.0, goodTotal / (double)waferCount, 1.0);
            Assert.AreEqual(40.5, levelThreeTotal / (double)waferCount, 1.0);
        }

        [Test]
        public void GradeOneTableYieldsOnlyLevelOneTest()
        {
            var result = ChipYieldDraw.DrawDicing(300, 0.15, new[] { 1f }, new CleanRoomDrawRandom(9L));
            Assert.AreEqual(1, result.GoodDieCountsByLevel.Count);
            Assert.AreEqual(300, result.GoodDieCountsByLevel[0] + result.FailedDieCount);
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/Yield/CleanRoomDrawRandom.cs`

```csharp
namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     清浄室の抽選に使う決定的な乱数列（SplitMix64）。同じシードからは同じ列が出る
    ///     Deterministic random sequence (SplitMix64) for clean-room draws; the same seed yields the same sequence
    /// </summary>
    public class CleanRoomDrawRandom
    {
        private ulong _state;

        public CleanRoomDrawRandom(long seed)
        {
            _state = unchecked((ulong)seed);
        }

        // [0,1) の一様乱数を1つ進めて返す
        // Advance the sequence and return a uniform double in [0, 1)
        public double NextDouble()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                _state += 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15UL;
                var z = _state;
                z = (z ^ (z >> 30)) * 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9UL;
                z = (z ^ (z >> 27)) * 0x94D049BB133111EBUL;
                z ^= z >> 31;
                return (z >> 11) * (1.0 / (1UL << 53));
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/Yield/ChipYieldFormula.cs`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     チップ歩留まりの確率式。抽選（ChipYieldDraw）とバランス計算が同じ式を共有する
    ///     Probability formulas for chip yield; the draw (ChipYieldDraw) and balance checks share them
    /// </summary>
    public static class ChipYieldFormula
    {
        // グレード上限＝装着品質モジュールの最高tier+1。品質モジュール無し（tier0）はG1だけ
        // Grade cap = highest equipped quality tier + 1; no quality module (tier 0) allows only G1
        public static int MaxWaferGrade(int highestQualityModuleTier, int gradeCount)
        {
            return Math.Clamp(highestQualityModuleTier + 1, 1, gradeCount);
        }

        // 1段の昇格確率 u = min(上限, 品質合計×クラス倍率)
        // Per-step promotion chance u = min(cap, quality sum x class multiplier)
        public static double PromotionChance(double qualityEffectSum, double classQualityMultiplier, double maxPromotionChance)
        {
            return Math.Clamp(qualityEffectSum * classQualityMultiplier, 0d, maxPromotionChance);
        }

        // クラス基準率を品質合計で割り引く。割引の上限は maxReduction
        // Discount a class base rate by the quality sum, capped at maxReduction
        public static double ReducedRate(double classBaseRate, double qualityEffectSum, double maxReduction)
        {
            return classBaseRate * (1d - Math.Clamp(qualityEffectSum, 0d, maxReduction));
        }

        // グレードgの確率。上限未満は u^(g-1)(1-u)、上限は u^(max-1)
        // Probability of grade g: u^(g-1)(1-u) below the cap, u^(max-1) at the cap
        public static double[] WaferGradeProbabilities(double promotionChance, int maxGrade)
        {
            var probabilities = new double[maxGrade];
            var reach = 1d;
            for (var grade = 1; grade <= maxGrade; grade++)
            {
                probabilities[grade - 1] = grade == maxGrade ? reach : reach * (1d - promotionChance);
                reach *= promotionChance;
            }
            return probabilities;
        }

        // 投入1枚あたりのレベル別良品ダイ期待値。全層成功×ダイ生存×グレード別ダイ表
        // Expected good dies per started wafer by level: all layers pass x die survival x per-grade die table
        public static double[] ExpectedGoodDiesByLevel(IReadOnlyList<double> gradeProbabilities, double layerFailRate, int layerCount, int diesPerWafer, double dieLossRate, IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<float>> gradeDieTables, int dieLevelCount)
        {
            var expected = new double[dieLevelCount];
            var survivingDies = Math.Pow(1d - layerFailRate, layerCount) * diesPerWafer * (1d - dieLossRate);
            for (var gradeIndex = 0; gradeIndex < gradeProbabilities.Count; gradeIndex++)
            {
                var table = gradeDieTables[gradeIndex];
                for (var levelIndex = 0; levelIndex < table.Count; levelIndex++)
                {
                    expected[levelIndex] += gradeProbabilities[gradeIndex] * survivingDies * table[levelIndex];
                }
            }
            return expected;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ダイシング1枚分の抽選結果。良品はレベル順（添字0=Lv1）、損失分は失敗ダイ
    ///     Dicing result for one wafer; good dies by level (index 0 = Lv1), losses become failed dies
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct DicingDrawResult
    {
        public readonly IReadOnlyList<int> GoodDieCountsByLevel;
        public readonly int FailedDieCount;

        public DicingDrawResult(IReadOnlyList<int> goodDieCountsByLevel, int failedDieCount)
        {
            GoodDieCountsByLevel = goodDieCountsByLevel;
            FailedDieCount = failedDieCount;
        }
    }
}
```

`moorestech_server/Assets/Scripts/Game.Block/Blocks/CleanRoom/Machine/Yield/ChipYieldDraw.cs`

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.Yield
{
    /// <summary>
    ///     ChipYieldFormula の確率で実際に引く。乱数は呼び出し側の決定的な列から取る
    ///     Draws with ChipYieldFormula's probabilities, pulling from the caller's deterministic sequence
    /// </summary>
    public static class ChipYieldDraw
    {
        // G1から始め、同じ確率で1段ずつ上げ、外れか上限で止める
        // Start at G1 and climb one step per success at the same chance, stopping on a miss or at the cap
        public static int DrawWaferGrade(double promotionChance, int maxGrade, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            var grade = 1;
            while (grade < maxGrade && random.NextDouble() < promotionChance) grade++;
            return grade;
        }

        public static bool DrawLayerFailure(double layerFailRate, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            return random.NextDouble() < layerFailRate;
        }

        // ダイごとに損失を判定し（損失数は二項分布）、残りをダイ表でレベルへ振り分ける
        // Roll loss per die (the loss count is binomial), then assign survivors a level from the die table
        public static DicingDrawResult DrawDicing(int diesPerWafer, double dieLossRate, IReadOnlyList<float> levelRates, CleanRoomDrawRandom random)
        {
            var goodCounts = new int[levelRates.Count];
            var failedCount = 0;
            for (var die = 0; die < diesPerWafer; die++)
            {
                if (random.NextDouble() < dieLossRate)
                {
                    failedCount++;
                    continue;
                }
                goodCounts[PickLevelIndex(levelRates, random.NextDouble())]++;
            }
            return new DicingDrawResult(goodCounts, failedCount);
        }

        // 累積比率で添字を選ぶ。丸め誤差で外れた分は最後のレベルへ寄せる
        // Pick an index by cumulative rate; rounding leftovers fall to the last level
        private static int PickLevelIndex(IReadOnlyList<float> levelRates, double roll)
        {
            var cumulative = 0d;
            for (var i = 0; i < levelRates.Count - 1; i++)
            {
                cumulative += levelRates[i];
                if (roll < cumulative) return i;
            }
            return levelRates.Count - 1;
        }
    }
}
```

```csharp
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Game.SaveLoad.Migration.Steps;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;

namespace Tests.UnitTest.Game.SaveLoad
{
    public class SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8Test
    {
        private const string ProcessorKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent";
        private const string WireKey = "Game.Block.Blocks.ElectricWire.ElectricWireConnectorComponent";
        private const string FailureLog = "版7から版8へ変換できません";

        [Test]
        public void 液体キーの無い清浄室機械へ空配列が足され他のキーは残るTest()
        {
            var processor = JObject.Parse("{\"cycleCount\":3,\"state\":0,\"inputSlot\":[],\"inheritedLevel\":1}");
            var save = Save(new JObject { ["blockGuid"] = "m", ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = processor, [WireKey] = new JObject { ["wires"] = new JArray() } } });

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            var migrated = (JObject)result.Save["world"][0]["state"][ProcessorKey];
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(new JArray(), migrated["inputFluidSlot"]));
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(new JArray(), migrated["outputFluidSlot"]));
            Assert.AreEqual(3, migrated["cycleCount"].Value<int>());
            Assert.AreEqual(1, migrated["inheritedLevel"].Value<int>());
            Assert.IsNotNull(result.Save["world"][0]["state"][WireKey]);
        }

        [Test]
        public void 清浄室機械でないブロックと既に液体キーを持つブロックは素通しされるTest()
        {
            var save = Save(
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"x\",\"state\":{\"ChestComponent\":{\"items\":[]}}}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"y\"}"),
                JObject.Parse("{\"blockGuid\":\"z\",\"state\":null}"),
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = JObject.Parse("{\"inputFluidSlot\":[{\"fluidGuid\":\"g\",\"amount\":5}],\"outputFluidSlot\":[]}") } });
            var original = save.DeepClone();

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsTrue(result.IsConverted, result.FailureReason);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(original, result.Save));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 再実行しても変化せず版はステップが書き換えないTest()
        {
            var save = Save(new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = new JObject() } });

            var first = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);
            Assert.IsTrue(first.IsConverted, first.FailureReason);
            var once = first.Save.DeepClone();
            var second = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(first.Save);

            Assert.IsTrue(second.IsConverted, second.FailureReason);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(once, second.Save));
            Assert.AreEqual(7, second.Save["worldVersion"].Value<int>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void FromVersionは7であるTest()
        {
            Assert.AreEqual(7, new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().FromVersion);
        }

        // 辿れない形は理由つきで拒否し、原本を変えない
        // Refuse unwalkable shapes with a reason and leave the original untouched
        [TestCase("{\"world\":{}}")]
        [TestCase("{}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[1]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":[]}]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":{\"Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent\":[]}}]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":{\"Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent\":{\"inputFluidSlot\":\"broken\"}}}]}")]
        [TestCase("{\"world\":[{\"state\":{\"Game.Block.Blocks.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineProcessorComponent\":{\"outputFluidSlot\":1}}}]}")]
        public void 辿れない構造は理由つきで拒否するTest(string json)
        {
            var save = JObject.Parse(json);
            save["worldVersion"] = 7;
            var original = save.DeepClone();
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(FailureLog));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsFalse(result.IsConverted);
            Assert.IsNotEmpty(result.FailureReason);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(original, save));
        }

        [Test]
        public void 後ろのブロックが壊れていても前のブロックを書き換えないTest()
        {
            var save = Save(
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = new JObject() } },
                new JObject { ["state"] = new JObject { [ProcessorKey] = new JArray() } });
            var original = save.DeepClone();
            LogAssert.Expect(LogType.Warning, new Regex(FailureLog));

            var result = new SaveMigrationStepV7ToV8().Migrate(save);

            Assert.IsFalse(result.IsConverted);
            Assert.IsTrue(JToken.DeepEquals(original, save));
        }

        #region TestHelper

        private static JObject Save(params JObject[] blocks)
        {
            return new JObject { ["worldVersion"] = 7, ["world"] = new JArray(blocks) };
```

```csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Core.Inventory;
using Core.Master;
using Game.Block.Blocks.Machine;
using Game.Block.Interface;
using Game.Block.Interface.Component;
using Game.Block.Interface.Extension;
using Game.CleanRoom;
using Game.Context;
using Game.Fluid;
using Tests.Module.TestMod;
using Tests.Util;
using UnityEngine;
using static Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine.CleanRoomMachineTestHelpers;

namespace Tests.CombinedTest.Core.CleanRoom.Machine
{
    // 工程用テスト機械（入力1・出力4・モジュール3・入力タンク1）の共通操作
    // Shared operations for the process test machine (1 input, 4 outputs, 3 module slots, 1 input tank)
    internal static class CleanRoomProcessMachineTestHelpers
    {
        internal const int InputSlot = 0;
        internal const int FirstOutputSlot = 1;
        internal const int OutputSlotCount = 4;
        internal const int FirstModuleSlot = 5;
        internal static readonly Vector3Int MachinePosition = new(2, 1, 1);

        internal static FluidId TestIpaFluidId => MasterHolder.FluidMaster.GetFluidId(Guid.Parse("00000000-0000-0000-1234-000000000003"));

        internal static IBlock PlaceProcessMachine()
        {
            return CleanRoomHatchTest.PlaceBlock(ForUnitTestModBlockId.CleanRoomProcessMachineId, MachinePosition);
        }

        internal static void SelectRecipeAndLoad(IBlock machine, Guid recipeGuid, ItemId inputItemId, int count)
        {
            var recipe = MasterHolder.MachineRecipesMaster.GetRecipeElement(recipeGuid);
            MachineRecipeSelectTestUtil.SelectRecipe(machine, recipe);
            machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>().SetItem(InputSlot, inputItemId, count);
        }

        // 入力タンクへIPAを足す。容量を超えた分は戻り値として捨てる
        // Add IPA to the input tank; anything over capacity comes back as the discarded remainder
        internal static void TopUpIpa(IBlock machine, double amount)
        {
            machine.GetComponent<VanillaMachineFluidInventoryComponent>().AddLiquid(new FluidStack(amount, TestIpaFluidId), default);
        }

        // 部屋を回しながら毎tickIPAを補充し、出力を全部回収する。回収数が目標に届くか上限tickで止める
        // Run the room, top up IPA and drain every output each tick; stop at the target count or the tick cap
        internal static Dictionary<ItemId, int> RunAndCollect(IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int targetOutputCount, int maxTicks)
        {
            var collected = new Dictionary<ItemId, int>();
            var total = 0;
            IOpenableInventory inventory = machine.GetComponent<IOpenableBlockInventoryComponent>();
            for (var tick = 0; tick < maxTicks && total < targetOutputCount; tick++)
            {
                TopUpIpa(machine, 20);
                TickRoom(filter, machine);
                total += DrainOutputs();
            }
            return collected;

            #region Internal

            int DrainOutputs()
            {
                // 別グレードで出力スロットが詰まらないよう、毎tick空にする
                // Empty the output slots every tick so a different grade never blocks them
                var drained = 0;
                for (var slot = FirstOutputSlot; slot < FirstOutputSlot + OutputSlotCount; slot++)
                {
                    var stack = inventory.GetItem(slot);
                    if (stack.Count == 0) continue;
                    collected[stack.Id] = CountOf(collected, stack.Id) + stack.Count;
                    drained += stack.Count;
                    inventory.SetItem(slot, ServerContext.ItemStackFactory.CreatEmpty());
                }
                return drained;
            }

            #endregion
        }

        internal static int CountOf(Dictionary<ItemId, int> collected, ItemId itemId)
        {
            return collected.TryGetValue(itemId, out var count) ? count : 0;
        }

        // 機械が加工を始める前に部屋をクラスA（閾値行0）まで清浄化する
        // Purify the room to class A (threshold row 0) before the machine starts work
        internal static bool WaitForClassA(CleanRoomDatastore datastore, IBlock filter, IBlock machine, int maxTicks)
        {
            for (var tick = 0; tick < maxTicks; tick++)
            {
                if (datastore.TryGetCleanRoomAt(MachinePosition, out var room) && room.ThresholdIndex == 0) return true;
                TickRoom(filter, machine);
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```
